results.translation: #ShallowTime# Thought reaching out would catch willow catkins, but opening my hand I saw a glimpse of sunset. I never really liked staying in one place too long, just as I never liked getting too familiar with anyone, because when the sun sets, eyes can no longer meet. In the evening, I always like to sit on steps, not dodging when the wind comes. Swaying leaves chat with each other, occasionally small groups gather by the greenery, children on the grass are happiest on Friday afternoons. Afternoon fragmented sunlight catches my face, dusk sunset stirs the dust, like slouching yet with nowhere to lean. What I love most is when night falls and crowds disappear, red lights only scattered faintly, slowing my steps I can sit anywhere. Summer, no longer afraid the night is too long, opening my eyes it's sunlight. Gained six more pounds, hello summer.

results.translation: In the middle of the night, I suddenly remembered when I was very, very young, my mother would watch the time during my nap, squat by the bed with snacks to coax me awake. I remember her smiling, crescent-shaped eyes and her softly calling me 'darling.' That certain, tangible feeling of being cherished was truly wonderful and I miss it. But from age two or three to now at twenty-three, aside from that time, I can't recall any other similar feelings. Parents aging and me growing up seem to have made us all less adept at expressing the love in our hearts. Of course I know 'this love isn't expressed not because it doesn't exist, but because everyone takes it for granted, so why mention it?' I feel awkward, too shy to say it, and of course others feel the same. I am loved. I'll call my mom tomorrow and chat more. I'll also finish the paper I've been procrastinating on until the last minute. Goodnight.

results.translation: Haven't written a casual journal in a while, let's jot down some recent updates~ Historically heaviest at 106 jin. Lost weight for art exams over a week-plus down to 96 jin. Then, three months prepping for the college entrance exam, eating takeout, snacks, late-night meals daily, plus three months of home-cooked and restaurant summer feasts—six months total—rose to 103 jin. Nearing the start of school, thought to lose some, dropped to 99 jin in a few days. Started school in Xiamen and went on eating sprees, but somehow maybe not eating extremely excessively? Still ate a ton, weirdly, plus walking to class and such (military training basically didn't count since I took sick leave, no training haha lazy method~). Result: by winter break heading back to Shenzhen, weight fell to 98 jin. Home for winter break, ate a lot but couldn't constantly order takeout or binge-eat due to the pandemic (normally at home, besides meals, I'd order multiple takeouts like milk tea, snacks daily—because only binge-eating makes me gain or maintain weight; if eating normally, I keep losing). Stuck at home, couldn't consume high-calorie milk tea, burgers, chicken wings frantically. Though made cakes, barbecues, and feasts at home, it was far from enough. So, post-pandemic, I slimmed to 92 jin, then traveled for two months, still eating lots but maybe due to walking, weight stayed unchanged. Finally, by September, quitting sugar, oil, fried foods for skin care, about two weeks, mostly eating dumplings and other low-sugar foods. Calories were normal, not worried about high-cal, but almost all high-cal foods are sugary/oily, so frustrating. Result: slimmed to 89 jin. After two weeks, weight unchanged, went to Xiamen, quit sugar again for a few days (less strict this time, didn't quit oil/fried), but dropped to 87 jin. Birthday plus holidays, ate feasts, milk tea, junk for over a week, now back to 89 jin. Though I look just fine, not scarily thin, 89 jin still sounds a bit terrifying. results.post_full: 睡着，突然想起那天早上从考场出来给爸爸打电话，接通后电话那头他妹妹在哭，说我爸在邛崃，听到这里以为爸爸有重伤去医院了，然后立刻她就说在火葬场，接着就是无数指责我的话，我没有听清楚…谁也不知道那些天我是怎么过的，不能去别人家串门，心里是巨大的痛苦和折磨，熬了几个通宵睡不着，堂姐有空就过来陪我说说话……我多希望妈妈在身边，亲人在身边，可是没有人出现在面前来帮助我，或者陪着我，好多无助，找不到任何人讲，无数次地期盼亲爱的兄弟姐妹谁能来看望我。爸爸，您在天有灵吗，看到你的家人是怎么对我吗？我明知道他们是因为爸爸有一点遗产来诘难我，也忍不住会把他的去世跟自己联系在一起。多么苦啊，谁知道。我一遍又一遍地问自己，究竟做错了什么，大家都要这样对我？难道是因为我天真，听话，去爱害我的人？我不想去承受这些，不想去管那些利益纠纷，奶奶那套房子是爸爸出钱的，但我也不想去争了，只求上天放过我，不要让我再和他们有任何交集，不要让我再遇到姓陈姓潘那样的人。我真的很穷，可是我不愿意再因为利益和他们争。
results.translation: Asleep, I suddenly remembered that morning when I came out of the exam hall and called my dad. When the call connected, his sister was crying on the other end, saying my dad was in Qionglai. Hearing this, I thought he was seriously injured and at the hospital, but then she immediately said he was at the crematorium, followed by countless accusations against me that I couldn't make out clearly... No one knows how I got through those days. I couldn't visit others' homes, my heart filled with immense pain and torment. I stayed up for several sleepless nights. My cousin came to keep me company and talk whenever she had time... How I wished my mom were by my side, my family were by my side, but no one appeared before me to help or accompany me. So much helplessness, with no one to talk to. Countless times, I hoped my dear siblings would come visit me. Dad, are you watching from above? Do you see how your family treats me? I know full well they're harassing me over Dad's small inheritance, yet I can't help but link his death to myself. So bitter, who knows? I ask myself over and over, what did I do wrong for everyone to treat me this way? Is it because I'm naive, obedient, and loving toward those who harm me? I don't want to bear this, I don't want to deal with these disputes over interests. Grandma's house was paid for by Dad, but I don't want to fight for it anymore. I just beg heaven to spare me, to not let me have any further dealings with them, to not let me encounter people with surnames like Chen or Pan again. I'm truly poor, but I'm unwilling to fight with them over money anymore.

results.post_full: 一个没有梦想的人，是一个不完整的人。让梦想成真，这是实现自身价值的重要途径之一。梦想是经不起犹豫的，在迟迟得不到实际行动的时候，梦想也就破碎了。没有实际行动，就算你有再美好的梦想，再完美的计划，都不过是个幻想。￼有了梦想，就应该为之努力，用实际行动去实现它。而不是坐等天上掉馅饼，等着梦想有朝一日，就自己实现了。在确定好目标以后，总会有那么一些的担忧，害怕过程太长，自己不能够坚持；害怕会失败；害怕太困难，自己不能够做好……正因为这种害怕的心理，在这世界上，能够真正实现自己的梦想的人少之又少。￼实现梦想首先就要“肯做”，然后在这个基础上“坚持做”。实现一个梦想，本来就不是一件容易的事情。没有谁是一步到位的，那些成功人士，在追求梦想的过程之中，总是表现出一种过人的毅力，在此期间，他们失败过很多次，可最终他们不还是成功了吗。著名演员史泰龙在高中的时候，就想要当一名演员。于是他去找那些导演和制片人，想要一个机会。可是整整三年，始终没有一个人看好他，没有人认为他是一个有表演天赋的人。在这三年之中，他从失败中总结了很多经验，终于一个拒绝了他20多次的导演给了他一个机会。正因为这个机会，他成了家喻户晓的明星了。￼你只闻到了他们的香水，却没有看到他们的汗水；你只看到他们光鲜亮丽的外表，却没看到他们遍体鳞伤的身体。梦想就是一场注定孤独的旅行，这路上少不了外界的嘲笑，和各种失败，但那又怎样，只要你脚踏实地的去做，才会离梦想越来越近。#正能量# 六盘水
results.translation: A person without a dream is an incomplete person. Making dreams come true is one of the important ways to realize one's own value. Dreams cannot withstand hesitation; when they are not followed by actual action for too long, they shatter. Without actual action, no matter how beautiful your dream or how perfect your plan, it is merely a fantasy. Once you have a dream, you should strive for it and realize it through practical action, not sit waiting for a pie to fall from the sky, hoping the dream will fulfill itself one day. After setting a goal, there are always some worries: fear the process is too long and you cannot persevere; fear of failure; fear it is too difficult and you cannot do it well... It is precisely because of this fear that very few people in this world truly realize their dreams. To realize a dream, you must first be "willing to do," and then on that basis, "persist in doing." Realizing a dream is never easy. No one succeeds in one step. Those successful people always demonstrate extraordinary perseverance in the process of pursuing their dreams. During this time, they failed many times, but in the end, didn't they still succeed? The famous actor Sylvester Stallone wanted to become an actor in high school. So he went to directors and producers seeking an opportunity. But for three whole years, no one believed in him; no one thought he had acting talent. During those three years, he learned many lessons from failure, and finally a director who had rejected him over 20 times gave him a chance. Because of that opportunity, he became a household name star. You only smell their perfume, but do not see their sweat; you only see their glamorous appearance, but not their bruised and battered bodies. A dream is a journey destined to be lonely, inevitably accompanied by external ridicule and various failures along the way. But so what? Only by doing things down-to-earth will you get closer and closer to your dream. #PositiveEnergy# Liupanshui

results.translation: #LateNightHorrorComics# #ChillingUponCloserThought# The Chilling Upon Closer Thought comic series appears normal on the surface, but upon careful consideration of the plot, inexplicable elements emerge. In this story, the key point of the four-corner game is that every fifteen minutes, someone accompanies another to chat, but actually, starting with four corners requires five people to complete. a goes to corner b to chat, then b goes to corner c to chat, c then goes to corner d to chat, when d goes to corner a, actually a is still at corner b, so who is d chatting with? That is the chilling aspect of this story upon closer thought.

results.translation: kbtsh82 Osmanthus, belonging to the family Oleaceae, is an evergreen shrub or tree. Also known as "muxi," common varieties include red osmanthus, golden osmanthus, silver osmanthus, and four-season osmanthus. Leaves are opposite and leathery, with flower clusters growing in leaf axils. Flowering period is September to October, fruiting period is March to April of the following year. Osmanthus produces small, golden-yellow flowers with a strong fragrance. It is one of China's top ten famous flowers. Native to China, it is widely cultivated across the country. Flower clusters grow in leaf axils; flowers are pale yellow-white with four lobes. The drupe is elliptical, turning purplish-black when ripe. The flowers are aromatic and used for fragrance extraction.

results.translation: Watching my daughter's life, I suddenly realized that although my childhood had various dissatisfactions, I was still happier than my daughter. Because I didn't have a mother chasing after me like a debt collector. I'm not saying it's better to have no mother, but I found that most mothers of our generation understood nothing—all they could give us was love and support. Today's mothers know much more, yet their children suffer various misfortunes, and they say it's for their future good.

results.post_full: 相比微信 更多东西我愿意放在微博里。恍惚间军训过去好几天了，今天上午休息的时候一中的同学们都在踢足球，可是我看着他们穿着红色的校服踢足球我突然想到初中了，想到我们初中的班足球赛的场面，眼泪一下就掉下来，也没人注意到我，我就悄悄地抹眼泪，后来看到了初中的同学，一下情绪就收不住了，哇哇地嚎，甚至我现在打字都在掉眼泪。红色的校服身上我看不到一点儿蓝色的影子，我真的太想太想初中了。我真的太难受了。我永远忘不了初中的球赛，忘不了那帮同学，忘不了我们在一起的三年，忘不了好朋友们在一起谈天说地的时刻，忘不了中考后班主任在我面前掉眼泪的画面。张老师，还有我亲爱的同学们，我真的好想好想你们啊。一中的老师同学都很好，可是我找不到初中的感觉了，我甚至觉得孤独，还有一种说不出来的无助，好像你们终将要离我而去。我好想十七班。
results.translation: Compared to WeChat, I prefer to share more things on Weibo. It feels like military training ended days ago. During the break this morning, students from No. 1 High School were playing soccer, but when I saw them wearing red uniforms, I suddenly thought of middle school—the scene of our class soccer match in junior high. Tears immediately fell, and no one noticed me, so I quietly wiped them away. Later, I saw a classmate from junior high and couldn't hold back my emotions anymore, crying loudly. Even now, as I type, tears are falling. In the red uniforms, I can't see a trace of blue. I miss junior high so, so much. I'm really heartbroken. I'll never forget the soccer matches in junior high, those classmates, the three years we spent together, the moments chatting and laughing with good friends, and the sight of our homeroom teacher crying in front of me after the high school entrance exam. Teacher Zhang, and my dear classmates, I miss you all so, so much. The teachers and students at No. 1 High School are great, but I can't find the feeling of junior high anymore. I even feel lonely and an indescribable helplessness, as if you are all eventually going to leave me. I miss Class 17 so much.

results.post_full: 手机真的对我来说 蛮重要的，有了手机我才能时时刻刻上网冲浪，和很好很好的朋友异地分享我的生活，絮絮叨叨说我生活中的点点滴滴。(大学🈚️朋友罢了，全是绿茶🍵)可是，我又在想，如果我有一天没有了手机，没有给朋友发消息，没有一直在微信上吵他们，他们会不会觉得不适应呢，会不会觉得少了一点什么。我觉得不会，因为没人会在意我的存在，我只是一个"朋友"不是他们生活的一部分啊。所以如果有一天我死了，或许也要等到很久很久之后，他们才会发现8⃣️。我不会觉得很惋惜什么的，毕竟别人也有自己的生活，要做到成为别人生活的一部分，真的太难辣！所以，如果我真的死了，谢谢作为朋友的你，最后发现了我的死亡，我也希望你能在我的墓碑前面放一束花，就一束，就够了。(说明你能够记得我了，我也会很开心)
results.translation: My phone is really quite important to me. Only with my phone can I surf the internet anytime, share my life with my very, very good friends who live far away, and chatter endlessly about every little detail of my life. (Just no friends in university, all are green tea bitches 🍵) But then I wonder, if one day I didn't have my phone, didn't send messages to friends, didn't constantly bother them on WeChat, would they feel uncomfortable, like something was missing? I don't think so, because no one cares about my existence. I'm just a "friend," not a part of their lives. So if I died one day, maybe it would take a very, very long time for them to discover it. I wouldn't feel particularly regretful or anything; after all, everyone has their own life, and becoming a part of someone else's life is really too difficult! So, if I really died, thank you, as a friend, for finally noticing my death. I also hope you can place a bouquet of flowers in front of my tombstone—just one bouquet is enough. (That would mean you remember me, and I would be very happy.)

results.post_full: 人与人之间的关系有太多变数，没规律可循。亲密关系会变质，低谷期的关怀会使原本陌生关系马上升温。形影不离的人会在某次平淡的告别后渐行渐远。所以没什么好计较的。所有不甘心的失去都可以靠时间和努力重新产生交集。如果不够努力，那就互相放弃。
results.translation: There are too many variables in human relationships, with no discernible patterns to follow. Intimate bonds can deteriorate, while care during low points can instantly warm up previously distant connections. Inseparable individuals may gradually drift apart after a seemingly ordinary farewell. Thus, there's little worth dwelling on. All reluctant losses can be reconciled through time and effort to rekindle intersections. If effort falls short, then mutual letting go is the path.

results.post_full: 永远不要指望别人对你的痛苦感同身受，你生不如死也好，你痛不欲生也罢，都只是你一个人的事情而已。即便是获取了别人的同情，里面也有可能包含了怜悯与敷衍这类的轻薄情绪，你又如何能指望别人解救你于水火之中呢，如果这痛苦不能让你变得愈加坚强，这痛苦来的又有何意义。
results.translation: Never expect others to empathize with your pain; whether you are living a life worse than death or suffering unbearably, it is solely your own affair. Even if you gain others' sympathy, it may contain shallow emotions like pity and perfunctoriness, so how can you expect others to rescue you from dire straits? If this pain does not make you stronger, what meaning does its arrival hold?

An unexpected gift received today still made me very happy. These things originally wanted to share day by day, but the dorm internet really makes me feel explosive so I blabbered a lot. Today's little happiness is a rare joy since school started. As for some bits of unhappiness, just forget them for now.

results.post_full: 毕业典礼上，校长宣布全年级第一名的同学上台领奖，可是连续叫了好几声之后，那位学生才慢慢的走上台。后来，老师问那位学生说："怎么了？是不是生病了？还是没听清楚？"学生答："不是的，我是怕其它同学没听清楚。"名与利是多少人的捆绑、多少人的心结？我们被教育要争气、要出头，但是争气出头的，不过是少数人，沉默的大众毕竟还多数。想一想，有那么多人都和你我一样，不也是很兴奋的一件事吗？#正能量# 六盘水
results.translation: At the graduation ceremony, the principal announced the top student of the grade to come on stage to receive the award, but only after calling several times did the student slowly walk up. Later, the teacher asked the student, "What's wrong? Are you sick? Or didn't you hear clearly?" The student replied, "No, I was afraid the other students didn't hear clearly." How many people are bound by fame and fortune? How many are troubled by it? We are taught to strive for success and to stand out, but those who succeed and stand out are only a minority; the silent majority is still the majority. Think about it, isn't it exciting that so many people are just like you and me? #PositiveEnergy# Liupanshui

results.translation: Recent reflections, my body seems to have had some minor issues lately. First, my ears couldn't hear, and after a round of IV drips and acupuncture, there was improvement, but then I suddenly got gastroenteritis with vomiting and diarrhea. A friend said this is a warning from my body and I must take it seriously, so I started adjusting my mindset and routine. For a long time before, I kept dreaming about saving the world, yet I couldn't save myself no matter what—could this be a hint to go easier on myself in life? Maybe I should just start living a life of a cup of tea and a newspaper a day ahead of time? But it seems I can't really stay idle. Sometimes I think, why am I pushing myself so hard? Just get by as best I can. Yet work and life keep pushing me forward. Ah well, just venting. I'll keep on living properly 🙃

results.translation: #DailyLife#1. Mom asked me after lunch yesterday if I knew there was an earthquake at home last night. I was clueless. Mom said I slept like a 🐷 so of course I didn't know. It reminded me of when a water pipe burst during my summer job, everyone got up to help, and I didn't budge either. I can't help but feel deeply concerned. 2. results.translation: If you truly wish me happiness, the only way I'll feel happy is if we get back together. You left me and still resent me—how could I possibly be happy? I even promised to wait for you for 10 years. These 10 years are the most valuable and precious time of my life, and I've devoted all of it to you. After these 10 years, I think I'll have no motivation to start another relationship. In fact, I'm willing to wait for you my whole life. I'm very persistent in everything I do, especially in love. No matter what I do, I put my heart into it. Mistakes are inevitable, but I strive to do better. That's why, to this day, I haven't had many romantic partners. If you truly wish me happiness, let's get back together. Deep down, you know there won't be another person as persistent, devoted, and faithful as me. @If the world weren't so unpredictable, why would forgiveness be necessary? Someone who can accompany you everywhere, travel all over, care for you wholeheartedly, and dare to promise your parents to love you for a lifetime—I doubt there will be a second person like that.

results.post_full: 这几年来我对自己当下的感情从来不会犹豫，喜欢你就告诉你，你不喜欢我那我就再争取一下，要是让你感到困扰有一点厌烦的话，那我就走。因为我没什么可失去的了。我所拥有的我相信她们不会离开，我珍惜着她们，所以我想他们也这样珍惜着我。我没什么可失去的了。而你呢，你是突然闯进我生命里的不速之客，我对你产生了“喜欢”，假如你恰好也喜欢我，那我们就在一起。你不喜欢我，那我们就再也不要往来。我们不用考虑未来，只要当下我们相爱，在一起开心，那就足够了。喜欢的发生本来就不容易，互相喜欢更不容易，假如还要考虑那么多，那人生也太难了。他们说我洒脱，其实我也不是洒脱，而是，我现在需要你，也能不需要你。我的生活本来就足够好，你是我的锦上添花，但没有你，我也一样的一如既往地好。
results.translation: Over the years, I have never hesitated about my current feelings. If I like you, I'll tell you. If you don't like me, I'll try a little more. If I make you feel troubled or a bit annoyed, then I'll leave. Because I have nothing left to lose. What I have, I believe they won't leave me. I cherish them, so I think they cherish me the same way. I have nothing left to lose. And you, you are an uninvited guest who suddenly barged into my life. I developed "liking" for you. If you happen to like me too, then we'll be together. If you don't like me, then we should never interact again. We don't need to consider the future; as long as we love each other now and are happy together, that's enough. Falling in love isn't easy to begin with, and mutual liking is even harder. If we still have to consider so much, then life is just too difficult. They say I'm carefree, but actually, I'm not carefree. Rather, I need you now, but I can also do without you. My life is already good enough on its own. You are the icing on my cake, but without you, I will continue to be just as fine as ever.

results.post_full: 每个年纪段都会有不同的想法 对待很多事物的认知也会产生不同的看法。一路成长，一路认清现实，和自己和解，寻找生活的意义。有的时候被情绪绑架是最痛苦的一件事，深陷在死胡同里，走不出来 哪怕拥有再多也不会感到快乐，焦虑 抑郁 痛苦时间久了就会得病。恶性循环，适当的和自己和解，学会调节情绪，其实快乐真的比什么都重要，成大事者 心理承受能力都会很强，而我没有这种能力，太过脆弱玻璃心，就不要逼着自己去承受那些承受不了的东西了。
results.translation: Each age brings different thoughts and varying perspectives on many things. Growing up means gradually recognizing reality, making peace with oneself, and seeking the meaning of life. Sometimes being held hostage by emotions is the most painful thing—trapped in a dead end, unable to escape, where even having plenty doesn’t bring happiness. Anxiety, depression, and prolonged suffering can lead to illness. It’s a vicious cycle. Making appropriate peace with oneself and learning to regulate emotions—in fact, happiness truly matters more than anything. Those who achieve great things have strong psychological resilience, but I lack that ability, being too fragile and sensitive. One shouldn’t force themselves to bear what they cannot endure.

results.translation: #ReadingList# "Dialogues from the Depths of the Heart" by Gu Cheng 20190522 is beautiful. It writes about people, human nature; it writes about scenery, beautiful views; it writes stories, capturing everyone's joys and sorrows, full of melancholy. Sometimes he is adorable, sometimes he is profound, sometimes he is affectionate. The two poems printed on the cover are his timeless masterpieces: one is "The night gives me black eyes, yet I use them to seek light," and the other is "You, now looking at me, now at the clouds. I feel, when you look at me, you are far away; when you look at the clouds, you are close." Brief yet profound, and full of beauty.

results.post_full: ［艺术咖］@蓬皮杜中心 之神仙眷侣温柔包裹    F爸爸和Z妈妈拿下跨学科人文艺术项目网页链接 ，需要吸收大量养分。视频《2分钟了解蓬皮杜大地艺术展》网页链接 就是课程之一。谢谢官V的转发，么么哒。今天加更12张图，从另一个角度来看展。    以下内容偏“工作思考日记”，如果想了解这场展览本身，艺术大V@-康定斯基的蛋-  发了一篇可读性很高的文 网页链接 谢谢被我高颜值蛋翻牌了，么么哒。.    还记得@克莱尔酱酱酱  带Z妈VIP看波尔坦斯基Christian Boltanski的展时，我俩被布展之精细缜密而震撼，惊呼OMG的次数绝对不亚于直播间的李佳琦。对，这就是蓬皮杜。无论什么展，空间设计、导览单、展签、灯光、展箱、定做的展墙、定做的画框、整体色调、放映空间、LED屏幕墙嵌入，没毛病。无论是三联画就用一面墙的培根Francis Bacon，还是尺寸各异材料称奇的杰夫·昆斯Jeff Koons，只要回顾展放在蓬皮杜，布展的“气”就是顺的。    这么多年来，唯一一次看到审美疲劳的展归吉亚科梅蒂Alberto Giacometti。是自己的原因，当时太年轻，还没走上艺术史教师的路。近几年能明显感受到蓬皮杜在调和重公共教育信息量，还是重观众体验舒适度，作出的尝试和努力。    “克里斯托与珍妮-克劳德: 巴黎！” 双人展的信息量&舒适感都兼顾到。蓬皮杜出手，作品数量是基本配备。在此基础上，时间线、主题区域、大招压轴，环环相扣。影像资料的辅助作用的度拿捏的非常精妙。大爱包裹新桥项目的卷宗档案，玲琅满目全被定制无反光框包裹起来。这个俏皮的无声文字游戏，着实法式浪漫。    展厅里用到很多墙面挖空设计，或是透明玻璃相隔设计，你看作品时，看同样作品的别人，同时也在看你。这种视觉搭脑回路不经意的期许碰撞，好啦好啦，Z妈妈承认，被甜到了。    最后，感叹爱了爱了学建筑设计出身的人儿。那些在图纸上手绘一丝不苟的线条，密密麻麻的数据和标示，强迫症重患表示极度舒适。.PS：亲子业务，蓬皮杜也很可：网页链接 妈妈带你看展览。.#艺术# #展览# #蓬皮杜中心# #遇见艺术# #带你看展览# #巴黎# #云看展# #带着微博看展览# #约会博物馆# #zafinparis#

results.post_full: #十九大#中国共产党第十九次全国代表大会中国共产党第十九次全国代表大会（简称党的十九大）于2017年10月18日在北京召开。党的十九大，是在全面建成小康社会决胜阶段、中国特色社会主义发展关键时期召开的一次十分重要的大会。承担着谋划决胜全面建成小康社会、深入推进社会主义现代化建设的重大任务，事关党和国家事业继往开来，事关中国特色社会主义前途命运，事关最广大人民根本利益。大会将选举产生新一届中国共产党中央委员会和中国共产党中央纪律检查委员会。
results.translation: #19th National Congress# The 19th National Congress of the Communist Party of China, held in Beijing on October 18, 2017, was a highly significant meeting convened during the decisive stage of building a moderately prosperous society in all respects and a critical period for the development of socialism with Chinese characteristics. It undertook the major task of planning the decisive victory in building a moderately prosperous society in all respects and advancing the socialist modernization drive, bearing on the continuity and development of the Party and the country's endeavors, the future and destiny of socialism with Chinese characteristics, and the fundamental interests of the broadest population. The Congress elected a new Central Committee of the Communist Party of China and a new Central Commission for Discipline Inspection.

results.translation: Many of my friends around me want to know why I don't want to tell them my Weibo. The reason is actually very simple. It's not that I'm putting on airs—a Weibo with hardly any followers can't really be about putting on airs. It's just that what's here isn't the me you see, the me you think is my usual self. Perhaps what gathers here are the saddest, darkest, most despairing things in my heart. All my intertwined love and hatred for this world will be confessed here. There are no acquaintances here to burden me; I don't have to create any persona. Here lies my past, my hopes, my ambitions, everything I'm willing to pour out. I don't know if I should let you see this utterly vicious me that exists here, the self I don't even know how to face.

results.translation: Those who can uphold the Lotus Sutra have already accumulated spiritual practice across trillions of Buddha-dharmas. Based on whether one can uphold the principles and meanings of the Lotus Sutra, you can examine your own spiritual level. The most crucial, vital issue is that the Lotus Sutra and the Shurangama Sutra everywhere speak of listening to sutras and hearing the Dharma, thereby ending birth and death and attaining Buddhahood in the present moment. The most critical issues are often the most obvious, needing no explanation—you understand at a glance. Yet many people fail to understand at first glance, fail after ten glances, cannot comprehend no matter how they look, and refuse to believe no matter how they are persuaded. Such individuals simply did not plant virtuous roots in past lives. If you do not believe the Dharma spoken by the Buddha in these king of sutras, the Lotus Sutra and the Shurangama Sutra, your practice is in vain. But some people believe and comprehend upon hearing.

results.translation: I've said so much to Huang Qianwen, and her thoughts are exactly the same as yours. Everything you've told me each time feels wasted, because you said not to be like this before my episode, but I still end up like this during an episode. You'll be disappointed again and again, Chen Han. You know, we've only been together for 8 months. My illness is chronic, it's been years. I can't just suddenly become someone who doesn't want to die. I want to die not because you're not with me, but because I truly know—every time you tell me so much to be well, to be okay, yet I can't control myself during an episode. I feel guilty. I really feel like I'm utterly useless, that's why I think of death. But would you believe it? You wouldn't, so I can only pretend each time, wrapping myself in a shell meant to threaten and upset you, to make you angry. I really know you understand how hard I try, but I hate myself for being useless, feeling like my brain is flawed for still being this way, and that's why I'm gradually seen as crazy.

results.post_full: 已是凌晨4点，身边的你已经睡去，而我确没有睡意，我们今天聊了很多，聊到你的以前，你上大学的时候，是怎么的开心，怎么无忧无虑，怎么的想尽所有办法吃到自己想吃的，从你的大学男友，聊到你现在的那个他，我傻傻的回应着，不想打断你，即使心里听了不会很舒服，但是毕竟都是过去，像这种话题，你不说给我听，也没有第二个会知道了吧，我喜欢做你的聆听者，喜欢你讲你每段故事，可能我没有你那么好的口才，谁让大哥我没有文化。其实我心里也有很多话想对你说，但是不知道是不是我敏感了，我觉得你没有从前那样有耐心，今天我们聊着聊着，也许你是不经意的说出你对我的看法，你说你对我恨铁不成钢，是啊，其实我们也许根本就不是一个层次的人，只是命运让我们相逢，相知，相遇，相爱，而且，还要爱而不得。
results.translation: It's already 4 a.m., you beside me have fallen asleep, but I have no drowsiness. We talked a lot today, about your past, how happy and carefree you were in college, how you tried every way to eat what you wanted, from your college boyfriend to your current him. I responded foolishly, not wanting to interrupt you, even though hearing it didn't feel comfortable inside, but after all, it's all in the past. Topics like these, if you don't tell me, probably no one else would know. I like being your listener, I like hearing each of your stories. Maybe I don't have your eloquence, but who says this big brother isn't cultured. Actually, I have a lot I want to say to you too, but I don't know if I'm being oversensitive—I feel you're not as patient as before. Today, as we talked, maybe you unintentionally shared your thoughts about me, saying you're frustrated with my lack of progress. Yeah, maybe we're just not on the same level, only fate brought us together, to know each other, meet, and love, and yet, to love without being able to have.

results.translation: Different acne types require different approaches, dear. For example, take non-red closed comedones—many people will tell you they're caused by dehydration and clogged pores, right? Then they suggest hydrating. But you can try it: see if heavy hydration makes this type of acne improve, and that will prove whether what they say is correct. In fact, hydration alone won't fix it. Some of these are caused by inflammation that creates bumps, and reducing inflammation will help them heal on their own. Others involve inflammation along with blockages, so after reducing inflammation, it's necessary to clear them out, then reduce inflammation again—that's the proper treatment for this acne type. How do you get rid of facial acne?

results.translation: [Tsubasa Chronicle Record Post] This kind of manga that masters diverse human emotions is so amazing. Even though I've never experienced such things, after reading it, I always feel as if I can empathize. I love this manga so much. It can be said that heart-wrenching stories leave a deep impression. The world brought by CLAMP is truly superb. This kind of advanced worldview is really astonishing. [The key is that it was created in that era.] I love every character; each brings me different feelings. There's no distinction of who is good or bad, right or wrong. Even Fei Wang, in my view, is just trying hard to fulfill his wish of revelling Yuko. From each person's different perspective, no one is wrong, but when they come together, conflicts arise. This creates the feeling that no one is wrong, yet everyone is at fault. In short, I am truly captivated by CLAMP's boundless imagination, tear-jerking plots, sincere and selfless friendships, and love that transcends time and space!

results.post_full: 今天我娃十个月了最近两周都没有更新辅食，也没有好好吃辅食。上周因为跟着奶奶在姨奶家，这周因为外公住院拆腿上的钢板我太累了从来没想过自己会闪婚，虽然是认识了八九年的朋友，也没想过结婚后会那么早要孩子，如果可以，我其实希望再过上一年二人世界再计划，就像《荼靡》里有句台词“我不要我的小孩是意外，不要他是妥协，是包袱，我要他是期待，是希望”但既然你来了妈妈也就做好准备成为一个妈妈，虽然我一直嚷嚷着我还没有玩够，还没有享受够自由从怀孕到你降生，妈妈也是满怀期待，去看去找去准备知识和物品，我认为我也是做好万全准备但事实上我还是手忙脚乱的，尤其是生完你后的这十个月，无力感一直存在。花自己的钱买奶粉买纸尿裤买玩具都要一一报备，好像以前那个风风火火，干脆利索的我不存在了，任性固执的我也不见了，我开始变的妥协，不断的理解，自我开解，这些都被总结为母爱大放光辉光辉，真的是这样么前年我爸受伤住院，躺在床上起不来我都没觉得这么累，今年仅仅小手术，我却觉得更累手术结束，我既要抱你又要推床，往返医院安全座椅哭闹不坐，挣扎着拽着我头发要来我怀里，没办法我只能骑摩托车，又担心你在医院抵抗力差把你留在家里，给你还不到12岁的舅舅看，送饭回来听他讲你找不到我哭的多惨前天午休，在床上看你玩着玩着我睡着了结果你掉床了，还好没摔倒哪里，把我心疼坏了，今晚在姨奶家，你又从沙发上摔了下去额头磕个包，妈妈心都要碎了，一闭眼就是你一遍一遍的摔下沙发，实在睡不下起来写写我要改变，为了你我也不会再妥协忍让了，以后我们过有质量的生活，不需要考虑太多，你有权利享受妈妈给予你的爱，妈妈也仅仅希望你衣食无忧，快乐健康成长，在爱，满足，包容，勇气中成长，十个月快乐王肉肉小盆友！（图为我回家做饭，回来我弟自豪的告诉我他自己晃悠了20多分钟哄睡的）我弟长大了
results.translation: My baby is ten months old today. I haven't updated about solid foods in the past two weeks, and he hasn't been eating them well either. Last week was because we were at my aunt's with grandma, and this week I'm exhausted because grandpa was hospitalized to have the steel plate in his leg removed. I never thought I'd have a whirlwind marriage, even though we were friends for eight or nine years, and I never thought we'd have a child so soon after marrying. If possible, I actually wished for another year of just the two of us before planning, like a line from the drama "Life Plan A and B": "I don't want my child to be an accident, a compromise, a burden. I want him to be an expectation, a hope." But since you came, Mom prepared herself to become a mother. Even though I kept saying I hadn't played enough, hadn't enjoyed enough freedom, from pregnancy to your birth, I was also full of anticipation, seeking out knowledge and preparing items. I thought I was fully prepared, but in reality, I've been scrambling, especially these past ten months since you were born. A sense of helplessness has been constant. Spending my own money on formula, diapers, toys requires reporting every item, as if the decisive, efficient me from before no longer exists. The willful, stubborn me is gone too. I've started to compromise, constantly understanding, consoling myself. All this gets summed up as maternal love shining brightly. Is it really like that? The year before last when my dad was injured and hospitalized, bedridden, I didn't feel this tired. This year, even with a minor surgery, I feel more exhausted. After the surgery, I had to hold you while pushing the bed. You cried and refused the car seat back and forth to the hospital, struggling, pulling my hair, wanting to be in my arms. I had no choice but to ride the motorcycle. I worried about your weaker immunity at the hospital, so I left you at home with your uncle who's not even 12 yet. Coming back from delivering food, I heard him describe how miserably you cried when you couldn't find me. The day before yesterday during a nap, I fell asleep watching you play on the bed, and you fell off. Luckily you didn't get hurt, but it broke my heart. Tonight at my aunt's, you fell off the sofa again and got a bump on your forehead. Mom

results.translation: I've been using my drawing tablet, but after buying an iPad, I found the iPad has a higher drawing output rate, so the tablet has just been sitting there... Later, sometimes when I encountered poor brush compatibility when importing into Photoshop and wanted the expressiveness that watercolor should have, I had to use both Photoshop and the iPad together. This led to the problem of being spoiled by the paper-like texture experience of the iPad's screen protector, making me feel that the so-called copy film that comes with the tablet is practically unusable. I asked around on Taobao and was told that the Wacom Intuos Pro doesn't have a paper-like screen protector... In the end, I was forced to flip the copy film over and use it. Today, I'm cleaning the double-sided tape off it. It's really too hard...

results.post_full: 因台风和地震无法看到的鲸和海豚，还安静的躲在花莲蔚蓝的大海深处。还记得那天我站在松山别院的阳台，眼前是一望无际的海，耳边是董运昌陈雅慧用吉他和曼陀铃合奏的《国境之南》，吹着海风，我把自己想象成多年前站在阳台的日本军官，想象他面对这片蔚蓝的大海，想着海的尽头的日本家人，渴望大海带去他的惦念，心里也跟着难过起来。但那时转身看到自己所爱所得就在身边，庆幸自己拥有了全世界。时隔三年，此时回望，我的全世界，真的，永远留在了那一刻。
results.translation: The whales and dolphins unseen due to typhoons and earthquakes still quietly hide in the deep blue sea of Hualien. I remember standing on the balcony of Songshan Villa that day, facing the boundless ocean, listening to Dong Yunchang and Chen Yahui's guitar and mandolin duet of "South of the Border." With the sea breeze blowing, I imagined myself as the Japanese officer who stood on that balcony many years ago, picturing him gazing at this blue sea, thinking of his family in Japan beyond the horizon, longing for the sea to carry his thoughts, and feeling sorrowful along with him. But then, turning around and seeing my loved ones and what I have right beside me, I felt grateful to possess the whole world. Three years later, looking back now, my whole world truly, forever, remained in that moment.

results.translation: 📚 I'm waiting for the wind and also waiting for you. 21 emotional stories about waiting, meeting, companionship, breakups, longing, sharing with you determined and courageous pursuits of love, unrequited loves that yield no results despite much thought, the joys and sorrows that twist and turn... These stories are like short microfilms about love. Each one stirs the emotions within, some will inexplicably bring tears to your eyes, some will make you smile knowingly, some will make your cheeks flush without you realizing, and some inevitably make you sigh with regret... Although I haven't experienced love, it seems like I can find my own shadow in some stories, occasionally empathizing. I've made this book my bedside book, reading it every night before sleep, sometimes one story, sometimes several. What this book taught me is to be fearless when facing love, and firm when doubting love. "When you no longer possess something, what you must do is to not let yourself forget" – this is a line from the movie "Ashes of Time." If you get a chance, watch this movie. Also, don't become a prisoner of time, don't be a clown who only compromises. So much, so much, it basically taught me to be a girl who understands love in relationships. Hope I can use it in future love hahaha. If I ever become an irrational fool in love, I hope this book can still come in handy hahaha. So next, it's time to switch to another book 📋 This one, "Being a Just-Right Woman," is said to be a life makeup book dedicated to all women. It says in this book you can find good prescriptions to help enhance your charm index and dig out success capital. Hahahaha, hearing that is quite tempting. Looking forward to it, so let's start today #LastDayOfMay#

results.post_full: 今天是八月十五。想要爬上屋顶赏个月学古人思念一下故人，被妈妈严肃的阻止了，于是坐在窗台上赏月，月亮真圆。摸到家里仅剩的一个月饼，还是五仁馅的。虽然早就被证实月亮上没有嫦娥，只有环形山，但还是觉得月亮上的阴影很像那颗怎么也砍不完的桂树。月亮好圆啊。
results.translation: Today is August 15th. I wanted to climb onto the roof to admire the moon like the ancients and reminisce about those gone, but my mother sternly stopped me, so I sat on the windowsill to gaze at the moon instead. The moon is so round. I found the last mooncake left at home, and it's filled with five-nut paste. results.translation: While traveling in the countryside, we saw an old farmer shoveling hay for his cow onto the eaves of a small thatched hut. Feeling puzzled, we asked, "Grandpa, why don't you put the hay on the ground for the cow to eat?" The old farmer replied, "This type of hay is of poor quality. The teeth with the rubber bands are moving at a snail's pace, and my upper lip got rubbed raw into an ulcer again; even with orthodontic wax on, it still hurts. This hurts, that hurts, lately my gums keep bleeding when I brush. Dr. Feng said my gums are a bit swollen and told me to brush harder, but brushing hard really hurts. When I left, I scheduled the next appointment for January 6th in advance. It's been almost a year like this, and the gaps between my teeth are still so big—the progress is so slow you can't even see it. It's been one year, should we celebrate? A very ceremonial happy one-year braces anniversary 😊 It will be happy, right!(^O^)y

results.post_full: 。　　总觉得我开始变成了一个尖酸刻薄又讨人厌的人。　　在很久之前，我记得我还是个很有耐心也算得上温柔的人，有人说过我倔，却从来没人说过我脾气不好，就连跟别人闹矛盾我也是温温和和的，几乎不讲一句重话。可是最近，具体就在这一次回家后，我突然就发现自己变得尖酸刻薄又易怒，连之前陪妹妹玩的耐心也几乎半点都不剩。　　我每次生气之后一直会想，到底是她们太过分了还是我反应过激了呢？　　比如那天我们部门的某个小干事因为某些原因少做了一期节目，其他人都几乎没什么反应就只有我内心实在是气愤，极其不友好的凶了他一顿，但其实我在和他聊天的时候已经在很努力的压着脾气，毕竟隔着屏幕我可以把自己的形象维持的温和一点。但是他还是悄悄的提过一声，xx学姐好凶啊。　　在面对别人的时候也许好很多，但是越跟我熟悉的人我就会越不客气，颇有些恃宠而骄的意味。　　但是，是很讨厌的那种恃宠而骄。　　前两天我和一个关系很好的男孩子聊天，他在学校表白墙上看见一张照片发给我，也许是单纯开玩笑的说你要不要试试这个小姑娘说的这个发型，或许是我那会儿本来情绪不高所以我说，不要谢谢。他大约还没察觉到我语气不对所以把这个玩笑继续了下去，然后我就看见他发过来这样一条消息，“而且你头发也不够长。”　　我知道他在开玩笑可我就是控制不住自己生气，然后我回复他，我头发够不够长关你屁事啊。　　怎么看都知道这绝对算不上什么好话，而我说这句话的原因仅仅是因为对方开了个无伤大雅的玩笑。　　莫名其妙的烦躁，莫名其妙的生气，我甚至都没办法好好的跟家人讲几句话。　　但是每次发完脾气又总是很自我唾弃，怎么会有这么讨人厌的人？　　怎么会有这么讨人厌的人呢。
results.translation: I always feel like I'm becoming a mean, nasty, and unpleasant person. A long time ago, I remember I was a patient and relatively gentle person. Some said I was stubborn, but no one ever said I had a bad temper. Even when I had conflicts with others, I was mild-mannered and hardly ever said anything harsh. But recently, specifically after returning home this time, I suddenly realized I've become mean, nasty, and irritable. I've even lost almost all the patience I used to have when playing with my younger sister. Every time I get angry, I keep wondering: Are they being too much, or am I overreacting? For example, the other day, a junior member in our department missed producing one episode of a program for some reason. Almost everyone else had little reaction, but I was genuinely furious inside and gave him an extremely unfriendly scolding. Actually, while chatting with him, I was trying very hard to suppress my temper—after all, behind a screen, I could maintain a gentler image. But he still quietly mentioned once, "Senior XX is so fierce." Maybe I'm much better when facing others, but the closer someone is to me, the less polite I become, somewhat like taking advantage of their affection. But it's the kind of taking advantage that's really unpleasant. A couple of days ago, I was chatting with a boy I'm very close to. He saw a photo on the school's confession wall and sent it to me, perhaps just joking, saying, "Do you want to try the hairstyle this girl mentioned?" Maybe because I was already in a low mood, I said, "No, thanks." He probably didn't notice my tone was off and continued the joke, and then I saw him send this message: "Besides, your hair isn't long enough." I knew he was joking, but I couldn't control my anger, so I replied, "Whether my hair is long enough is none of your damn business." Anyone can tell that's definitely not a nice thing to say, and I said it just because the other person made a harmless joke. I get inexplicably irritable and angry; I can't even have a proper conversation with my family. But every time I lose my temper, I always feel intense self-loathing: How can there be such an unpleasant person? How can there be such an unpleasant person?

results.post_full: 从大学伊始至今，一直陪伴着我的漂移板。它陪我走过这六年时光，与我一起共患难同进退，一起体验生活的酸甜苦辣，已然成为我心中不可磨灭的一份记忆。我相信每个人都会有自己的爱好，既然喜欢就把它坚持玩下去吧，在这个现实的世界，往往不得不妥协，能在夹缝中做自己喜欢的事也是难能可贵。滑板人的精神就在于此！#长沙##漂移板##滑板##比较冷门的个人爱好##致自己##王一博# @UNIQ-王一博 男神的魅力影响着我们每一个人！ 长沙 长沙漂移板大胖的微博视频
results.translation: From the beginning of university until now, my driftboard has been with me all along. results.translation: I feel so sad, I want to cry. It might be because I was triggered by troublesome people and things, touching on loneliness. Although I don't think I am lonely, the sorrow that surges when I'm alone makes me feel it's because of loneliness. I knew there would be a second even if there wasn't a first, I just didn't expect it to be so soon. Being fragile-hearted is useless, I can only reboot this way, I really despise it. But losing control is infuriating, the second one is no good, all signs indicate it. But on the surface, they still wouldn't dare offend me, who knows what happens behind my back, there are already signs of interference. Honestly, I really don't like it. I just shouldn't show it too obviously, but I can't control myself, damn it. The first one was better, at least it didn't make me dislike it, and it was also kind.

results.translation: Depression. I have a responsible mom. After learning about my illness, she took me to the provincial capital again and again for medical treatment, trying various methods for me, whether traditional Chinese medicine or Western medicine, hoping I could get better. I am proud to have such a mom. Although she has a bad temper, I know it's because she's under a lot of pressure managing me alone. Everyone has their temper; I understand her. A retired woman, she goes out to work again and again to cover my medical expenses. Every time I think of this, tears flow down. My biological father ignores me and doesn't care about me, but at least my mom hasn't given up on me. However, I feel like I won't get better. Currently preparing for the postgraduate entrance exam, under immense pressure, I forget whatever I study. What should I do? I don't want to disappoint my mom, but I'm really exhausted.

results.post_full: 销我亿劫颠倒想  不历僧祇获法身         这就是讲「华开莲现，即悟即证」！其它方便法中，藏教修无量劫不能明心见性，修通教别教恒河沙数的人难有一个人成就，无量百千万亿劫也难得成就。唯有《法华经》《楞严经》之「一心三藏」，来一个成就一个，来两个成就一双，百分之百，千分之千，万分之万！而且成就高，下可保底不落六道轮回，上不封顶直到十地等觉，乃至像龙女那样成为究竟圆满之佛！就是成就率百分之百，成就的品位高！成就的时间呢，你可以一生成就，也可以一个月成就，也可以一天成就，也可以一时一念成就！所以观照这段经文，就销除我无量劫以来的颠倒妄想啊！有哪些颠倒妄想呢？时间上颠倒：时间上有过去、现在、未来。空间上有颠倒：东南西北上下十方（其实都是一念）。佛法上、世间法上有颠倒：认为什么法门都能成佛。种种的相貌上颠倒：有你、我、他。所以这个「颠倒」呢，我们从时间、空间、佛法、万法之相这四个角度来观照。   这么多颠倒啊，「不历僧祇获法身」呐！不需要经过无量百千万亿年而「获法身」，也就是说我当下就已经见到了法身，获得了法身。圆顿大法这个「获」视同于「证」。圆顿大法只愁悟，不愁证！在见道位所见到的真如与在证道位所证到的真如无二无别，你明心见性的当下就是如如佛。这是讲《楞严经》它的妙用不可思议！过去执着在时间是过去、现在、未来，是不是？那现在明白就是当下一念；过去执着十方虚空无穷大，现在知道都是当下自己一念心；过去认为太阳、月亮、山河大地、树木华草是无情；过去认为牛马猪羊、张三李四都是他，现在知道都是自己一个念，没有哪一法不是哪一法；过去认物为己，认己为物；现在来讲，己也是物，物也是己。大光明中谁非谁？这些颠倒想一颠就颠过来，无始以来的颠倒想当下一念就明白。这叫「一灯能除千年暗，一智能灭万年愚」！        下面的「不历僧祇获法身」是重复解释上面一句话，一念明白过来了，销去颠倒想了，叫「知妄即真，华开莲现，当下成佛」！所以别教菩萨从空出有，在通教禅宗的基础上从空出有，还要修三大阿僧祇劫！三大阿僧祇劫只能证到二行位的菩萨，也叫佛。比圆教佛还要低三十个等级，更何况别教以下，通教、藏教、小乘法更不用谈。可是到了圆教，成分真即佛，乃至到地上菩萨、十地菩萨、等觉菩萨都可以一生成就——一生就是我们这个人一生短短几十年，几十年就能成就，也可以一个月成就，可以一个时辰成就，甚至可以一念就成就，这叫「不历僧祇获法身」。「僧祇」，，是从别教往前讲，就不知道哪个猴年马月才能成就。圆顿大法是无量无量劫的功德，成就于一生一时一念当下，这是不可思议的大法呀！这里的「获」就是「悟」，就是证得。所以有些受方便法影响的人，把这个「获」看成是见道，他把见道和证道分开。对于方便法而言，见道以后要修要证，因为他那种见道还有漏，没有见全，见的是有或者见的是空，或者见的是亦有亦空，都不圆满。那种见道，那种所谓的悟解，必须要解行并重。所以他那种说法把「获」说成见道、悟解，并且还要修、还要证并没有错，因为他见得不圆满。对于圆顿大法，见道即是修道、即是证道。所以圆顿大法「不历修证、不历次第，无修无证，即见即修即证」。       佛在《法华经》《楞严经》就是这么讲啊！摩登伽女是个下九流的坏女人，听佛讲几句话当下证三果罗汉，再听文殊菩萨讲了几句偈颂，当下证四果罗汉；舍利弗和憍陈那听佛讲了一遍苦集灭道，当下证四果罗汉。这还是讲小乘法呀！讲大乘法，八岁的龙女听文殊菩萨讲了《法华经》，当下成为妙觉位的佛—圆满之佛！《法华经》《楞严经》里这样的例子很多啊！无量百千万亿的众生听佛讲一段经、一品经乃至半个小时的开示，当下无量的人成为阿罗汉、辟支佛、住位菩萨、行位菩萨、回向位菩萨、地上菩萨、直至十地、等觉位。印光大师是近代高僧，印光大师一世的精华就是四句话：「法华奥典，妙冠群经，闻即往生，位齐等觉」!《楞严经》从头到尾几乎都是在讲，成佛就是当下的事！当下！
results.translation: It dispels my countless kalpas of inverted thoughts, without traversing asamkhyeyas one attains the Dharmakaya. This explains "the flower blooms and the lotus appears, awakening is immediate realization"! In other expedient teachings, the Tripitaka teachings practice for immeasurable kalpas yet cannot illuminate the mind and see one's nature; among those practicing the Prajna teachings or the Distinct teachings, as numerous as the sands of the Ganges, it is difficult for even one to achieve attainment; even over countless hundreds of thousands of millions of kalpas, achievement is exceedingly rare. Only the "One Mind, Threefold Truth" of the Lotus Sutra and the Shurangama Sutra ensures that whoever comes achieves attainment—one comes, one achieves; two come, a pair achieves—one hundred percent, one thousand per thousand, ten thousand per ten thousand! Moreover, the attainment is of high grade: at minimum, it guarantees not falling into the six realms of rebirth, and at maximum, it is unbounded, reaching even the ten grounds and equal enlightenment, or like the Dragon Girl, becoming a completely perfect Buddha! That is an achievement rate of one hundred percent and a high grade of attainment! As for the time of achievement, you can achieve in one lifetime, or in one month, or in one day, or even in an instant, in a single thought! Therefore, contemplating this passage of scripture dispels the inverted delusions I have harbored over immeasurable kalpas! What inverted delusions are there? Inversion regarding time: time is seen as past, present, and future. Inversion regarding space: east, west, south, north, up, down, the ten directions (all are actually a single thought). Inversion regarding Dharma and worldly phenomena: believing any method can lead to Buddhahood. Inversion regarding various appearances: existence of you, me, and him. So, we contemplate this "inversion" from these four perspectives: time, space, Dharma, and the characteristics of all phenomena. So many inversions are dispelled, and "without traversing asamkhyeyas one attains the Dharmakaya"! Without needing to pass through countless hundreds of thousands of millions of years, one "attains the Dharmakaya," meaning I have already seen the Dharmakaya in the present moment, attained the Dharmakaya. results.translation: Doing nothing is just you avoiding reality. I've thought about it for a long time, and I still feel that neither living nor death itself has any meaning, nothing in itself has meaning, meaning itself doesn't exist, it all depends on how you look at it. There is no reason that supports my will to live, only when I feel there is something that can make me look one more time, listen one more time, eat one more time, laugh one more time, can it support me to wake up after falling asleep. But as soon as I'm among people, I feel my existence is unnecessary.

results.post_full: 我妈留够一周的吃的 匆匆回国了 回去的最后一刻还在炖排骨 做臊子面，汤 ，包饺子馄饨 ，烙我爱吃的饼，把家里所有的花草都浇好了 中药也熬够了俩天的 我妈就是这么一个总为别人考虑特别勤劳的一个人 。我在机场没忍住还是大哭了起来 本来不想失态让我妈担心的。虽然我还有俩个多月也要回国 但感觉分别总是这么漫长 况且就算回国也还是要再回来的。最近总是会想起小时候的事儿 细节都会想起来 有时候甚至会沉溺很久 回过神来时特别沮丧 不知道是不是这个病的表现形式。本来这俩天涨奶厉害，我妈一回去我连着哭了几场好像也回奶了。。小魔王希望你这周能乖一点 不要太折磨我，你奶奶下周就来了 妈妈就可以安心去吃药治病 我想回到从前那个没心没肺的自己 。我做不了伟大的妈妈 只希望能是个快乐的妈妈。
results.translation: My mom left enough food for a week and hurried back to China. Up until the last moment before leaving, she was stewing pork ribs, making minced meat noodles, soup, wrapping dumplings and wontons, baking my favorite pancakes, watering all the plants at home, and even prepared enough traditional Chinese medicine for two days. My mom is just that kind of person—always considerate of others and incredibly hardworking. I couldn't hold back and cried loudly at the airport; I didn't want to lose composure and worry my mom. Although I'll be returning to China in just over two months, goodbyes always feel so long, and even after going back, I'll have to return here again. Lately, I often recall childhood memories, remembering even the details, sometimes getting lost in them for a long time, and feeling particularly down when I snap out of it—wondering if this is a manifestation of my illness. Recently, I've had severe breast engorgement, and after crying several times since my mom left, it seems my milk supply has decreased... Little troublemaker, I hope you can be good this week and not torment me too much. Your grandma will be here next week, and then I can focus on taking medication and treating my illness. I want to go back to being my carefree self. I can't be a great mom, I just hope to be a happy one.

results.post_full: 又是为这永远摆脱不了的麻烦哭泣，哭得眼睛疼，眼泪流过我严重敏感的脸，刺痛的很。我满脑子都是我死掉的样子，可能吐着白沫，可能流了满地血，可能摔得面目全非，可能被水泡的发涨...这些场景在我脑子里闪闪闪，怪吓人的。我还是很害怕死亡的，怕痛，怕死相太难看吓着别人，怕被“救”回来结果要活受罪。这大概也是我说服自己不要自杀的一种法子吧，毕竟自杀实在是太麻烦别人了。我还有点不舍，我还没去见过哥哥。我想看他在他热爱的舞台上唱歌跳舞发光发热，想看他开心地笑，想看他温柔地跟粉丝挥手，我还想近距离看看他俊美的脸，想闻闻他身上淡淡的香，想听他说话，或者安静地跟着他身后看他也好。我心里还装着这样美好的人呢，所以我还是活着吧。
results.translation: Crying again over this trouble I can never escape, crying until my eyes hurt, tears streaming down my severely sensitive face, stinging sharply. My mind is filled with images of my own death—maybe foaming at the mouth, maybe bleeding all over the floor, maybe smashed beyond recognition, maybe bloated from soaking in water... These scenes flash through my mind, terrifyingly. I'm still very afraid of death—afraid of pain, afraid my corpse will be too ugly and scare others, afraid of being "saved" only to suffer more. This is probably also a way I convince myself not to commit suicide, since suicide would really trouble others too much. I still have some reluctance—I haven't gone to see my brother yet. I want to see him sing and dance, shining brightly on the stage he loves, want to see him smile happily, see him wave gently to fans, I still want to see his handsome face up close, smell the faint scent on him, hear him speak, or just quietly follow behind him and watch him. I still hold such a beautiful person in my heart, so I'll keep living.

results.translation: #Skincare# The British little blue tin feels quite moisturizing on the lips, but it's super cooling, as if I applied a thick layer of peppermint oil. I usually use it as an overnight lip mask. Recently my lips have been in bad shape, and thick application of the little blue tin didn't seem to have any effect. For daily use, after applying it, I feel the skin on my lips becomes hard, and I can't help but want to bite or peel it, so its repairing power is practically non-existent for me. Pawpaw ointment, however, was a pleasant surprise. I've occasionally used it as a lip balm, but it's a bit too greasy, so I don't use it often, and I prefer small bags, so carrying it isn't very convenient. Before, my lips didn't have such big issues, so I didn't want to apply pawpaw ointment thickly either (it's really a bit greasy, and I'm afraid it'll get on the pillow). Recently, I've been wearing makeup every day, barely applying lipstick, always touching it up. I don't like using lip balm, and I love peeling the skin off my lips and applying dry lipsticks (Chili every day). So, I finally experienced my first lip crisis. The little blue tin didn't work, so as a last resort, I tried pawpaw ointment, applying it thickly overnight, and the next day it was much better! Surprise! It made my newly ordered lip balm useless, hahaha.

results.translation: November 13th, "Water" Because I'm always asking for leave, my academic advisor suggested I take a leave of absence from school. In an instant, I was completely stunned. The word "leave of absence" brought back all sorts of painful memories from high school, like a balloon pricked by a needle, rapidly exploding. I fell asleep last evening and woke up suddenly for no reason, followed by panic; in my dazed state, it felt like my soul had been pulled away. It's colder today, the dorm air conditioning is off, winter has truly arrived. Beginning hibernation.

results.translation: Suddenly remembered a cute thing from high school. There was a boy I really liked. One day he changed his hairstyle, and when I texted him, he even sent a preview photo. On the day school started, I was wondering when I'd see him. Then, while queuing in the cafeteria at noon, I turned around and he was right behind me. That boy was already good-looking, and with his new curly hair, he looked especially adorable. I just kept staring at him, completely forgetting I was in the lunch line. Maybe he felt a bit awkward, so he asked me, "Does it look good?" (Honestly, when I saw him, I was completely stunned—how could he be so handsome? I really wanted to reach out and ruffle his hair, cup his face in my hands and squeeze it, then shout, "You're just too cute!") But since I was in the secret crush phase, I could only pretend to be slightly surprised and say, "It's pretty good." (Yet I had a lewd smile on my face, my cheeks were aching...) A few days later, I noticed he had changed his hair back. I don't remember if I asked him why he changed it again; I just figured it was his preference and didn't want to pry. Sometimes I blame my memory for remembering everything, and when I look back, it's always more bitter than sweet—just licking sugar off broken glass.

results.post_full: 微信朋友圈已很久没有更新了，没有关注我的人，也没有想让看的某人。我在想，三十多岁的我，把日子过得稀碎，很挫败。有时候会埋怨父母一直以来的的批评教育，把我养育的足够自卑，一直认为自己不配得不配爱，说什么做什么都是错的。这是原生家庭带给我的根深蒂固的影响。第一段婚姻像一滩死水，没有生活默契，没有未来期望。图物质？各花各的，产检，生娃，养娃都是自己掏钱。图感情？吵架离家出走，从来不担心不紧张不联系。图脾气好？确实，三脚踹不出一个屁，能把人活活憋死。就这样彼此耗了7年，留给我一套房子一个娃娃。从此甚少联系。第二段婚姻像过山车，原本幸福的生活，未来的憧憬，瞬间崩塌。嫖娼，跟前任纠缠，网赌，打麻将，怀孕一次家暴，往死里朝头部和肚子挥拳头，坐月子一次家暴。说出来可笑，住着我的房子，花着我的钱，辱骂殴打我和大儿子，我还百般迁就讨好他，我可能是脑子有病吧。最后一次家暴，我让他滚出了我的家。传说中二婚，留给我70万的负债一个娃娃。于是，我终于作死成功，把自己作成了负债70万，无业，肥胖，抑郁，带俩娃的单亲老妈子。怪谁？不怪任何人，都怪自己，没有自信没有眼光没有底线没有本事，好吃懒做坐享其成。活该这个结果。为自己的选择负责。我不会做祥林嫂，以后也不会再提原生家庭，更不会再提两次失败的婚姻，此生不会再碰爱情和婚姻。当下，承担责任，抚养好两个孩子，调整自己的心态和生活，努力工作赚钱，踏踏实实的过好自己的日子。
results.translation: My WeChat Moments haven't been updated for a long time. There's no one paying attention to me, nor anyone specific I want to see it. I'm thinking, in my thirties, I've made a complete mess of my life, and it's very defeating. Sometimes I resent my parents' constant criticism in raising me, which made me sufficiently insecure, always believing I'm undeserving and unworthy of love, feeling that everything I say or do is wrong. This is the deep-rooted influence my family of origin has had on me. My first marriage was like stagnant water—no默契 in life, no expectations for the future. For material gain? We spent our own money separately; prenatal checkups, childbirth, and raising the child were all paid for by myself. For感情? When we argued and I left home, there was never any worry, concern, or contact. For a good temper? True, you couldn't get a word out of him with three kicks; it was enough to suffocate you. We dragged on like this for seven years, leaving me with a house and a child. Since then, we've had little contact. My second marriage was like a roller coaster; what was originally a happy life and future dreams collapsed instantly. Prostitution, entanglement with an ex, online gambling, mahjong, domestic violence once while pregnant—fists aimed at my head and stomach trying to kill me, and domestic violence again during postpartum confinement. It's laughable to say—living in my house, spending my money, verbally abusing and beating me and my eldest son, and yet I still tried in every way to please him. I must have something wrong with my brain. The last time he was violent, I kicked him out of my home. As the saying goes about second marriages, it left me with 700,000 in debt and a child. So, I finally succeeded in ruining myself, turning into a single mother with 700,000 in debt, unemployed, obese, depressed, and raising two kids. Who's to blame? No one but myself—no confidence, no discernment, no底线, no ability, lazy and wanting to enjoy without effort. I deserve this outcome. I take responsibility for my choices. I won't be like Xianglin's Wife; I won't mention my family of origin again in the future, nor will I bring up my two failed marriages. I will never touch love or marriage again in this lifetime. For now

In recent weeks, numerous universities have seen the emergence of "praise groups." These groups mostly have a rule: only compliments are allowed, no mockery. "In the group, no matter what you say, you'll receive a dazzling array of praises from everyone. No trolls, no mutual insults, only sources of joy and laughter." Some group members feel that "everyone can still joke with a hint of sweetness in the bitterness, which is quite delightful." Regarding the phenomenon of "praise groups" sweeping across universities, a sociology expert stated that students' desire for praise indicates a lack of encouragement in their lives. results.post_full: 美食 不可辜负的美食 香港 大学Vlog6 ｜在香港｜麦当劳｜逛超市｜石澳小岛｜多鹤野日式料理｜艺术馆看展｜一兰拉面｜除夕夜｜拍全家福｜家庭烧烤      香港的石澳小岛真的很棒，和长洲岛相比这里的游客比较少，很适合周末出来野餐或者放松，有海有草地，有高尔夫球场有很棒的brunch。吹吹海风，绕绕小路，烦躁的心情被安抚不少，岛上的生活真的好惬意啊。      今年我们还是回老家过年，年夜饭、压岁钱、放烟花、全家福…今年又过了一个好年，只可惜病毒来的太猖狂了，大家在老家呆的日子只有短短4天，很多人再见又是明年冬天。      去年我明白了不是所有的努力都有回报。不过即使失败了，当你回过头看你这一路的付出，其实你也收获了许多。时间说溜就溜走，当我发现我没有了要等的人，也没有了陪我一起等的人的时候，才知道年少的爱情、友情、亲情真的都太宝贵啦。现在，从此刻开始，都要好好珍惜身旁的人，也要加倍爱自己噢！ #vlog# #我的vlog生活# #不可辜负的美食# #吃货在这里# #吃吃吃# #美食# #遇见美好# #拯救不开心#  #旅游# #香港# #石澳#  #跨年# #新年快乐# #除夕夜#  做个好梦把的微博视频 香港
results.translation: Food, unmissable food, Hong Kong University Vlog6 | In Hong Kong | McDonald's | Supermarket shopping | Shek O Island | Takuraya Japanese cuisine | Art gallery exhibition | Ichiran Ramen | New Year's Eve | Family photo | Family barbecue. Shek O Island in Hong Kong is really great; compared to Cheung Chau Island, there are fewer tourists here, making it perfect for weekend picnics or relaxation. There's the sea, grass, a golf course, and excellent brunch. Feeling the sea breeze and wandering the small paths soothes a lot of restlessness; life on the island is truly so leisurely. This year we still returned to our hometown for the New Year: New Year's Eve dinner, red envelopes, fireworks, family photos... we had another good New Year, but it's a shame the virus came so fiercely. We only stayed in our hometown for a short four days, and for many, we won't see each other again until next winter. Last year I learned that not all efforts yield rewards. But even if you fail, when you look back at what you've put in along the way, you've actually gained a lot. Time slips away so quickly. results.post_full: 看的脑壳疼，黑话太多了。尼采批判了早年崇拜对象叔本华和瓦格纳，并将他们当做对跖者，从生理学上对瓦格纳的音乐进行批判。他认为瓦格纳的音乐是藏在理想光环中的虚无主义，是灾难性的蛊惑人心的。拿代表作帕西法尔说，是一部充满险恶复仇的作品，是病态的基督教道德的表现。尼采认为瓦格纳是一个“演员”，其实书中并没有对他作曲层面的批评，尼采还是承认瓦格纳在那个时代是最牛皮作曲家，最多就是提到了“旋律非道德”。瓦格纳在歌剧上的创新，取消宣叙调，咏叹调，合唱等固定套式的段落，用“无终旋律”来取代，还有介乎说与唱之间的“念唱旋律”。但尼采认为瓦格纳中的音乐元素都是不真实的，而是虚无的表演性质。感觉更多的是两个人观念和宗教信仰的分歧。想的太多真的会发疯，所以尼采疯了。
results.translation: Reading this gives me a headache, too much jargon. Nietzsche criticized his early idols Schopenhauer and Wagner, treating them as antipodes, and critiqued Wagner's music from a physiological perspective. He believed Wagner's music was nihilism hidden in an ideal halo, a disastrous seduction. Taking the representative work Parsifal as an example, it's a work full of sinister revenge, an expression of pathological Christian morality. Nietzsche considered Wagner an "actor"; actually, the book doesn't criticize his composition level—Nietzsche still acknowledged Wagner as the most awesome composer of that era, at most mentioning "melodic immorality." Wagner's innovations in opera, abolishing fixed patterns like recitative, aria, and chorus, replacing them with "endless melody," and the "Sprechgesang" between speaking and singing. But Nietzsche believed the musical elements in Wagner were inauthentic, but rather nihilistic performance. It feels more like a divergence in their ideas and religious beliefs. Thinking too much really can drive one insane, so Nietzsche went mad.

results.translation: I encounter all sorts of people every day, but they are all in groups or pairs. I'm not envious, but I have discovered a weakness of human nature: I've found that not liking to express oneself and not being talkative will lead to disadvantage in any group. On the day I sprained my ligament, I went to see the doctor alone. I hobbled alone to take a bus to the clinic. All the way, I knew that just a little more and I wouldn't be able to hold back, I would cry. Indeed, while waiting in line, I cried twice. I couldn't hold back. Perhaps I felt miserable, perhaps I felt very lonely, perhaps I felt a bit wronged, perhaps I felt I had no one to rely on, or perhaps I just felt like crying. The night before last, lying in bed, I also really wanted to cry, and I did cry. Why am I so, so, so lonely? Why am I still so fragile? No matter where I go, I am unwilling to talk about my past, as if my past were somehow disgraceful. It's just that I don't want to talk about a past that even I don't approve of. It feels awful. Said I was on vacation to have fun and go skiing, but ended up injuring my foot. Not worth it. I've found that some people talk better than they sing. I've found that when it comes to matters of interest, I still don't like it.

results.translation: I think I should write something. This is already the second time I've had doubts about this city I liked. The first time, in September 2017, my car was parked within the marked lines on the street opposite the Municipal Public Security Bureau, and the window was smashed. The second time was on the afternoon of May 16, 2019, in Liangshan. My car was parked within the marked lines on the street near the Exit-Entry Administration, which is a paid parking zone. After I finished my business and returned, I found deep, sharp scratches from the rear fender to the front fender and both doors on the left side of my car. When I argued with the parking attendant, I was told to wait for the company to resolve it. Later, the area manager from the smart parking company outsourced by Xichang City Investment Company arrived and called the police. Officers from Xichang Xijiao Police Station came and asked me and the smart company to go to the police station for negotiation. At the station, the area manager called two groups of people from the smart parking company to resolve the issue, but none offered a practical solution—they all shirked responsibility. Even the police officer told them that since they charged for parking, a contractual relationship was formed, and they should compensate for the damage. But the company said the car owner should find the perpetrator. How am I, as a car owner, supposed to find the perpetrator? Probably because they saw my car had a Sichuan A license plate, they drag their feet since they're in no hurry and have no willingness to take responsibility. I could restore my car to its original condition myself, but I want to use this incident to let more people voice their opinions about the management of Xichang City. As a tourist from out of town, it was supposed to be a happy trip, but it ended up being disheartening. Other cars weren't scratched—only the out-of-town license plate was targeted. I have video evidence. The officers at Xijiao Police Station were very responsible but couldn't do anything about the company outsourced by City Investment. We can only accept our bad luck. I sincerely hope the local government will supervise and manage such outsourced companies! @CCTV News @Xichang City Affairs @Love Liangshan Xichang @Chengdu Business Daily @Cover News @Xichang Metropolitan Daily @Xichang Police Sichuan Province · Liangshan Yi Autonomous Prefecture Jiachi Chain

results.translation: Someone asked me what's the difference between having two children and one? 1. There were no two children in my life plan; I thought one was just fine. Rationally, I probably still wouldn't plan for a second child, but when an unexpected one comes, everything is worth it! 2. Especially during the pandemic months this year, I realized having an extra child at home makes it lively. Both have a companion and aren't lonely; everyone likes company, big or small. When the older one gets bored, they play with the younger one; the younger one sticks to the older one. 3. Financially, one more child definitely increases expenses, but it absolutely boosts Mom and Dad's desire to earn money. We'll put a lot of thought into how to earn more without lowering our quality of life. Our consistent parenting philosophy is to strive our hardest to provide you with life's necessities, not extras or luxuries. You must be capable of supporting yourselves and not have a dependent mindset. 4. I don't expect to raise children for old-age support, but I think two will be livelier than one when we're old. 5. Up to now, I've come to accept all kinds of lifestyles. Living alone is fine, living as a couple is fine too; what suits you is best, there's no fixed model. But given his family situation, having two children makes the home lively, adding another touch of life's warmth to the household, which is also my sentiment towards him. #Growth##SecondChild##Family##TheLookOfLife##Parenting##FamilyEducationTogether##MomSharing##ParentChildEducation#

results.post_full: 第一次一个人去看病，是在高一的时候。我是藉由着跟家里人说，“我和同学去逛街”偷跑去医院的。第一次自己去医院，手忙脚乱的，挂号、找科室、付费等等都花了老半天。我原以为这一天就可以把我的病看好了，结果医生给我开了张单子，告诉我：“下周一上午来做心脏彩超。”那一瞬间，我慌了。周一是要上课的，我不可能翘课自己偷跑来；既然不是偷偷出来，势必是要告诉父母了。我害怕的是，我父母要知道了，要知道，我一个人来看病。他们会心疼，为什么我不告诉他们，自己一个人偷跑出来。而这，恰恰是我一个人出来的原因。我不想让他们为我担心。毕竟还是个高一的学生，没经历过这样的事情。中午，我出医院后，大脑空空的，也不知道往哪儿走。因为和母亲说了，是和同学出来玩，势必不可能这时候回家的，作息就要做全套。我慌乱地打电话给我最好的朋友，支支吾吾地跟她说，“我今天去医院了，我好像，生病了…”这时候我才恍然意识到，我害怕的，不仅是事情败露，还有对疾病的未知的恐惧。这对于16岁的孩子还是挺难接受的。我一辈子都感谢我那个最好的朋友，她陪伴了我那最忐忑不安的一个下午，尽管我们已经分道扬镳。最后，晚上，我还是和父母坦白了。我哭得稀里哗啦的，父母都以为我是害怕生病，只有我自己知道，我是在内疚，“对不起，让你们担心了。”周一，去医院检查，查出患有先心病。预约专家门诊，复诊，寒假安排了手术，再复诊。我的亲戚们都知道我一个人看病的事，都感叹我是个好懂事的小孩。这是我最不喜欢听到和发生的情况。我为什么不想告诉我父母呢？因为我母亲查出脑瘤，只有两年半的时间了，知道这消息时的我是初三。我真的真的，不想再让她操心了。真的，两年半，不早不晚，她很准时地离开了我。这三年里，我每一个辗转反侧的夜里，都能想起她离开的那个夜晚。而我也将永远忏悔。“对不起，没有好好陪你。”“对不起，让你担心了。”
results.translation: The first time I went to see a doctor alone was in my first year of high school. I sneaked off to the hospital by telling my family, "I'm going shopping with classmates." It was my first time going to the hospital by myself, and I was all flustered—registering, finding the department, paying, and so on took me ages. I thought I could get my illness treated that same day, but the doctor gave me a slip and said, "Come next Monday morning for an echocardiogram." In that moment, I panicked. Monday was a school day; I couldn't skip class and sneak out again. Since I couldn't go secretly, I would inevitably have to tell my parents. What I feared was that my parents would find out—they would find out that I had gone to see a doctor alone. They would feel heartbroken, wondering why I didn't tell them and instead sneaked out by myself. And that was precisely why I went alone. I didn't want them to worry about me. After all, I was still a first-year high school student and had never experienced anything like this. At noon, after leaving the hospital, my mind went blank, and I didn't know where to go. Since I had told my mom I was out with friends, I couldn't go home at that time—I had to keep up the act. Frantically, I called my best friend and stammered, "I went to the hospital today... I think I'm sick..." It was only then that I suddenly realized what I was afraid of wasn't just being found out, but also the fear of the unknown illness. For a 16-year-old, that was quite hard to accept. I will always be grateful to that best friend of mine, who stayed with me through that most anxious afternoon, even though we have since gone our separate ways. In the end, that evening, I confessed to my parents. I cried uncontrollably. My parents thought I was scared of being sick, but only I knew it was guilt: "I'm sorry for making you worry." On Monday, I went to the hospital for the examination and was diagnosed with congenital heart disease. I scheduled an appointment with a specialist, followed up, had surgery arranged during winter break, and followed up again. My relatives all found out that I had gone to the doctor alone and praised me for being such a sensible child. That was the situation I least wanted to hear about or experience

results.post_full: 所以，允许自己犯错，允许自己搞砸一些事，接受自己处于并将长期处于迷茫状态，接受自己暂时的穷且平凡，然后带着一颗强大的心脏，不怕失败地往前走吧。       别人的选择看似很好，但不一定适合你；别人的生活很好，但那也不是你焦虑迷茫的理由。每个人都有自己的生活方式，无所谓好坏，仅此而已。        迷茫是常态，却也是动态可变的。你只须接受自己的选择，并且坚持下去。只要你愿意努力做出改变，那些让你糟心的状态都会慢慢好起来。　　更重要的是，生活很少能完美，我们在享受自己选择所带来的好的同时，也必然要接受其中的不够好。        人最怕的不是困难挫折，而是在困难挫折面前顾影自怜。你要有一颗能抵御世事艰难的雄心，而不是过分柔软只会心疼自己。
results.translation: So, allow yourself to make mistakes, allow yourself to mess some things up, accept that you are and will remain in a state of confusion for a long time, accept your temporary poverty and ordinariness, and then move forward with a strong heart, unafraid of failure. Others' choices may seem good, but they might not suit you; others' lives are good, but that's no reason for your anxiety and confusion. Everyone has their own way of life, with no inherent good or bad, that's all. Confusion is the norm, but it's also dynamic and changeable. You just need to accept your choices and persist. As long as you're willing to work hard to make changes, those distressing states will gradually improve. More importantly, life is rarely perfect; while we enjoy the good that our choices bring, we must also accept the not-so-good aspects. What people fear most is not difficulties or setbacks, but self-pity in the face of them. You need a heart ambitious enough to withstand life's hardships, not one that is overly soft and only feels sorry for itself.

results.post_full: 躁郁症有很多时候会想，或许有什么法子是可以解决这些看起来并不严重实际却很要命的问题的，只是还没寻到而已。生活在这个世界上，除非成功了，否则说什么都是个笑话。老人们用一辈子所经历的人生波折来劝慰年轻人：不要太猖狂。但总没人愿意听。过山车并不是最好的比喻，因为从过山车上下来，还能回到原本的生活里，但这些波折，没有回头路。“一点制服不了的小情绪算什么？你只是还没遇到人生的大起大落大灾大难罢了。” 落进这样的圈里，困住的只有自己而已。道理都懂的，就像吃药身体也会免疫一样，排解的法子也会一个又一个失灵。以前爱喝酒，抽烟，爱看些血淋淋的片子，用一切不美好的事情来麻痹自己，这个人间还值得。每回一次重庆，就会证明一次，来来往往，除了看客在看笑话，没有值得。还小的时候，不太懂为什么生活如此艰难，还要不辞辛苦地活着，以为长大了会懂。其实长大了也不会懂，不是问题不在了，而是放弃了。才知道，原来吃糖也还是会苦。
results.translation: With bipolar disorder, there are many times when I think maybe there is some way to solve these problems that don't seem serious but are actually deadly, it just hasn't been found yet. Living in this world, unless you succeed, anything you say is a joke. Old people use a lifetime of life's ups and downs to comfort the young: don't be too arrogant. But no one is ever willing to listen. A roller coaster isn't the best metaphor, because you can get off a roller coaster and return to your original life, but with these ups and downs, there's no turning back. "What's a little uncontrollable emotion? You just haven't encountered life's major rises and falls, disasters and calamities yet." Falling into such a trap, the only one trapped is yourself. I understand the reasoning, just like the body can become immune to medicine, the methods of release also fail one after another. I used to love drinking, smoking, watching bloody movies, using all kinds of unpleasant things to numb myself, thinking this world is still worth it. Every time I return to Chongqing, it proves once again, coming and going, except for onlookers watching the joke, nothing is worth it. When I was young, I didn't quite understand why life is so hard and we still labor tirelessly to live, thinking I'd understand when I grew up. Actually, you don't understand when you grow up either; it's not that the problems are gone, but that you've given up. Only then do I realize that even eating sugar can still be bitter.

results.translation: Day 101. Learning to drive today was really exhausting. The student council transition happened today, and I've finally broken free from this place. Do I feel reluctant? No. Do I feel grateful? Yes. I'm very glad that in my freshman year I didn't encounter a bureaucratic senior from my direct major, and in my sophomore year, my junior was a considerate sweetheart. But I still detest the pressure this place put on me—the handfuls of hair I lost in the winter of 2019, the endless sleepless nights, the unceasing tears, the never-ending tasks, the constant scoldings. I've finally turned in my answer sheet. Here, I've done my absolute best. I give myself 90 points on this test. I hope there is no future like this. I hope the mountains are high and the road is long from now on, and we never meet again.

results.post_full: 1211📆 39+5🕒 待产日记📝 今晚心情很难受，也没有什么特别的原因吧，就是突然好想哭。可能是感受到我的情绪波动，宝宝一直在动个不停。因为她的大幅度动作，我也被折腾得无法入睡，又胡思乱想了一番。说不上是谁在影响谁，因为直到这一刻，我们依然是一个个体，你仍是我密不可分的一部分。把手搭在肚子上，好像抚摸着宝宝，然后突然意识到，像这样的时刻，也许明天后天就结束了，而且此生永远不会再有了。一想到这，老母亲突然又有些按捺不住的伤感了。
results.translation: 1211📆 39+5🕒 Labor Diary📝 Tonight I feel very upset, for no particular reason, I just suddenly want to cry. Perhaps sensing my emotional fluctuations, the baby has been moving non-stop. Because of her big movements, I'm also being tossed around and can't sleep, and my mind is wandering again. It's hard to say who is influencing whom, because until this moment, we are still one entity, you are still an inseparable part of me. Placing my hand on my belly, as if stroking the baby, and then suddenly realizing that moments like this might end tomorrow or the day after, and will never come again in this lifetime. Thinking of this, this old mother suddenly feels an uncontrollable sadness again.

With your smile, next year will still be beautiful.

results.post_full: 连续闷热了好几天，南京终于在今天迎来了一场属于盛夏的暴雨。放假已经好几天了，撑着伞走出G组团的时候，眼帘里除了漫天的雨只有寥寥几个行人，也同样撑着形形色色的伞沿着马路走向自己的目的地。我还是选择从两旁种满榉树的那条道路走向我自己的目的地。每次走这条路我都怀抱着一种莫名的情感，不论是晴天还是下雨天，也不论是冬天还是夏天，它好像都有自己独特的样子。两旁的榉树长得又高又直，随性生长的纤细枝叶在马路中央的上空汇合，春天会冒出很浅很浅的绿色的叶子，到了夏天浅绿色会慢慢变得更深，就好像被盛夏的阳光晒得老化了一样，秋天开始掉叶子，所以冬天的时候抬头只能看见光秃秃的树枝了，幕布是灰沉沉的天空。四季流转里，只有来来往往的同学陪着这些树，以及两旁的红墙与河水。今天终于是有暴雨的日子了，马路上不再是一成不变的树荫轮廓，而是稀里哗啦的小水流。因为没有人，所以我肆无忌惮地踩着中线一步一步地走，溅得自己满脚满裤子的水也毫不在意，急速降落在我的伞面的雨水又顺着脊线下落，为我隔出一个朦胧胧的小世界。在我的记忆里，每一个盛夏都应该有一场说来就来的暴雨的，即使把所有的门窗都关好，还是听得见屋外水花四溅的声音，所有的乌云遮蔽了天空，所以室内也是一片昏暗。等到暴雨停歇，就可以见到被雨洗过的天空，被雨洗过的空气，被雨洗过的叶子……被雨洗过的一切，连夏日的暑气都被清洗一空，轻轻地嗅一嗅，还能闻到未消散完的涩涩的雨水的味道啊。这场雨所有的水如果没有来得及挥发一空的话，会顺着蜿蜒的道路一直汇聚到长江，最后奔流入海。所有天上来的精灵，最后都会回到大海的怀抱里，这样一想，好像有点浪漫的样子❤ 南京·中国药科大学(江宁校区)
results.translation: After several consecutive days of sweltering heat, Nanjing finally welcomed a summer downpour today. It's been several days since the holiday began. When I walked out of Building G with an umbrella, my view held nothing but the sweeping rain and a few scattered pedestrians, also holding various umbrellas, walking along the road toward their destinations. I still chose to walk toward my own destination via the road lined with zelkova trees. Every time I take this road, I'm filled with an inexplicable emotion. Whether it's sunny or rainy, winter or summer, it seems to have its own unique appearance. The zelkova trees on both sides grow tall and straight, their freely growing slender branches and leaves meeting overhead in the middle of the road. In spring, very pale green leaves emerge. By summer, the light green slowly deepens, as if aged by the midsummer sun. Leaves begin to fall in autumn, so in winter, looking up, you only see bare branches against the backdrop of a gloomy, gray sky. Through the changing seasons, only the coming and going students accompany these trees, along with the red walls and the river on either side. Today finally brought the heavy rain. The road was no longer a monotonous silhouette of tree shade but filled with the sound of rushing little streams. Because there was no one around, I walked unabashedly down the center line, step by step, not minding the water splashing all over my feet and pants. The rain rapidly landing on my umbrella flowed down the spine, creating a hazy little world around me. In my memory, every midsummer should have a sudden, heavy downpour. Even with all the doors and windows closed, you can still hear the sound of water splashing outside. All the dark clouds blot out the sky, so the indoors are dim too. When the rain stops, you can see the rain-washed sky, the rain-washed air, the rain-washed leaves... everything washed by the rain, even the summer heat cleansed away. Take a gentle sniff, and you can still smell the lingering, astringent scent of the rain. If all the water from this rain doesn't evaporate in time, it will flow along the winding roads, eventually converging into the Yangtze River and rushing out to sea. All the spirits from the sky eventually return to the embrace of the sea. Thinking of it this way seems a bit romantic ❤ Nanjing · China Pharmaceutical University (Jiangning

results.post_full: 夜思集：①睡觉是人世间最好的馈赠。②55岁阿姨情感分享，只顾眼前珍惜眼前的快乐。当眼前的快乐积累到一定数值时，会慢慢成为永久的快乐。当她和小三岁的初恋在一起时，所有人都不认同且觉得不会长久，可是他们已经恩爱了这么多年。且如酒般醇厚，越爱越深。③医院这个地方，生死场景太多了。水池边闲谈随便几句话就能懂得所有由来，太多遗憾也有太多情感。我对此的定义和理解好像在慢慢加深也在慢慢接受。④我拒绝长大的本质原因是逃避现实，这是别人给我一针见血的回复。深知但宁愿逃避，不愿自己独力是因为觉得累和疲惫。可这就是长大，也因此领悟会更深刻。⑤关于朋友，善意和恶意总是会突然存在的矛盾体。那些说着你要是有什么问题就打电话给我们，反正我们闲大抵是可以交心的人了。因为他们的善意是保留联系，汲取温暖，与之而来的恶意则是满满的“威胁”，我若不打电话随即将我拉黑这种话也是从他们口中而来。⑥太多人说活在当下了，那么如何活在当下。若将生死看淡，一切好像也都失去了创造的意义。可这却给予意义仪式感，你的每一个选择行为和对话都会进入一种“活在当下”的模式中。芜湖#困##夜思集##睡眠是馈赠# 芜湖·弋矶山医院
results.translation: Night Thoughts Collection: ① Sleep is the best gift in the world. ② A 55-year-old aunt shares her feelings, focusing on cherishing the happiness before her eyes. When the happiness before one's eyes accumulates to a certain amount, it slowly becomes permanent happiness. When she got together with her first love who is three years younger, everyone disapproved and thought it wouldn't last, but they have been deeply in love for so many years. And like wine, it becomes richer and deeper with time. ③ In hospitals, there are too many scenes of life and death. A casual chat by the water fountain can reveal all the origins; there is too much regret and too much emotion. My definition and understanding of this seem to be slowly deepening and slowly accepting. ④ The essential reason I refuse to grow up is to escape reality, which is the blunt reply others gave me. I know it well but would rather escape; I don't want to be independent because I feel tired and exhausted. But this is what growing up is, and because of this, the understanding becomes more profound. ⑤ Regarding friends, kindness and malice always suddenly coexist as contradictions. Those who say "if you have any problems, just call us, we're mostly free anyway" are probably people you can confide in. Because their kindness is to maintain contact and draw warmth, while the accompanying malice is full of "threats"—words like "if you don't call, I'll block you immediately" also come from their mouths. ⑥ Too many people talk about living in the moment, so how does one live in the moment? If you become indifferent to life and death, everything seems to lose its meaning of creation. Yet this gives meaning a sense of ritual; every choice, action, and conversation you make enters a mode of "living in the moment." Wuhu #tired# #Night Thoughts Collection# #Sleep is a Gift# Wuhu · Yijishan Hospital
