results.post_preview: 我这个人做什么都考虑后果，可是我的人生还是那么糟糕。仙人掌不是花，没人会捧在手心里。你生活在光亮里，就觉得全世界都是光亮的。生物的本能叫趋利避害，人们看到糟糕的东西都想要远离，只有看到美好的东西才会想...
results.post_full: 我这个人做什么都考虑后果，可是我的人生还是那么糟糕。仙人掌不是花，没人会捧在手心里。你生活在光亮里，就觉得全世界都是光亮的。生物的本能叫趋利避害，人们看到糟糕的东西都想要远离，只有看到美好的东西才会想要靠近。不要拒绝悲伤，只管去难过，去愤怒好了，忍不住眼泪，那就尽情的哭吧。我的梦里一直有一条过不去的大河，我像是去过那里，又像从来没有去过。仙人掌浑身带刺，无法成为花朵。当受害者变成施暴者，当看客变成助推，在这一场名为“玩笑”的闹剧中，没有旁观者，只有施暴者。等风雪吹过，留我冰霜一朵，让我记得世界寒冷，但你温暖如河。不要对我那么好，要不我会以为你做什么事情都是理所应当的。悲伤就像一条大河，或许会吞没你，但也能带你去梦想的远方。我这个人做什么都考虑后果，可是我的人生还是那么糟糕。愿世间所有人的青春都能被温柔以待。
results.translation: I always consider the consequences of everything I do, yet my life remains so miserable. A cactus is not a flower; no one will hold it in their hands. You live in brightness, so you think the whole world is bright. The instinct of living beings is to seek advantage and avoid harm; people want to stay away from terrible things and only want to get close to beautiful things. Don't refuse sadness; just go ahead and be sad, be angry. If you can't hold back tears, then cry your heart out. In my dreams, there has always been an impassable river; it feels like I've been there, yet also like I've never been. A cactus is covered in thorns and cannot become a flower. When victims become perpetrators, when onlookers become enablers, in this farce called a "joke," there are no bystanders, only perpetrators. When the wind and snow pass, leaving me a frosty bloom, let me remember the world is cold, but you are warm as a river. Don't be so good to me, or I'll start thinking everything you do is taken for granted. Sadness is like a great river; it may drown you, but it can also carry you to the distant place of your dreams. I always consider the consequences of everything I do, yet my life remains so miserable. May the youth of everyone in this world be treated with gentleness.

results.translation: #People with poor memory should diligently record things# When did I start realizing my memory isn't great? Probably when I opened my old diary and wondered, did I really experience these things? I have no memory of them. Wang Xiaobo said some things aren't recorded in history, they only exist in the minds of those who lived through them, like personal collectibles. Once we die, those things vanish. That's quite true. But for people with poor memory, you don't even have to wait until death—just a few years, and many things are gone. Perhaps this is the meaning of words and images. If you don't want to forget, Weibo, Douban, and social media feeds are good memory storage strips. Early aging symptoms, sigh. 1. Tonight I ate two grilled fish, a piece of cake, and a big handful of "dog food" from Comrade Dabi (referring to witnessing public displays of affection). This single dog (single person) is quite full. 2. Having a Brother Qun who doesn't treat guests but can secure sponsors is pretty good. We can freeload on food and drinks, even if it's just superficial office colleague relationships. 3. While freeloading tea, I cut two bitter gourds for my uncle and achieved a level I can't usually manage at home. I think the only difference between me and a chef is lacking a good knife.

results.post_full: 奶柚无敌#毕竟是柚子同人文# 【小白X柚子】你一根我一根，咦，怎么只有一根辣条了？（一）        想写狗柚子的同人文好久了，这篇文是块小甜饼呀。请大家多多支持呀！不定期更新，看我心情，不过应该是个小短篇，白柚大军，给我站起来！！！ 文案：电竞文，ABO设定 最强阿珂柚子X国服韩信小白 并不王者的王者文。前方注意！十分沙雕。         柚子是这两年在斗鱼直播上凭借一手戳屁股能手的刺客阿珂爆红的王者荣耀主播，也是现在活跃在一线的主播中少有的omega。        王者荣耀是最近比较热门的一款团队竞技类游戏，在游戏中，柚子主要操作的是打野这个位置的英雄。第一次直播柚子打的是雅典娜，是个死亡后在峡谷上空飘着盯着队友，给队友增加鸭梨的英雄，对于操作的要求还是蛮高的，需要满脑子的献祭想法。        简直是玛丽苏男主的标配好嘛，我弄不死你我就去死！        柚子并不是职业玩家出身，简单点说吧，职业队里的教练嫌他吃太多了，把他扔出来了，所以没上的了职业战场。第一次直播他的水平其实在其他主播看来不算好，还需要再磨练一下，但是长得又圆，又有说垃圾话的天赋，比如，小老弟，你怎么肥似，天生就是吃这碗饭的料。       一张圆润的脸庞怼着镜头，小小的眼睛紧紧盯着你，话都不用说，小姐姐们就都忍不住捂住心口开始大声嚎哭：胖柚子！！！木由子！！！爸爸爱你！！！        第一次直播后，柚子被一个浑身发着闪光的小戴姐姐看上，参加了一场由斗鱼举办的DSF比赛，只能在斗鱼直播上看见的小比赛。比赛里，他担任的是ADC的位置，传说中的太阳落山了的后裔。        凭借这场比赛，柚子也被斗鱼发现了稍许的潜力，虽然不算一飞冲天但也能说算是主播途坦荡？了。        柚子本来是传媒大学新闻系的学生，结果还没等他开始做新闻，自己先变成新闻了。        因为前几次的游戏直播的人设都比较逗比，不过还有出彩的部分，比如说拿刺客打野，恰好柚子最近找到了一个适合他的戳屁股的英雄——阿珂，按狗柚子的话来说，从背后戳，百分百暴击的最适合他这个脸黑的人了，所以经济公司就干脆给他艹了一个最强戳屁股能手的人设。柚子自己都觉得这狗屁人设实在过分沙雕，但是，生活不易，忍了。        不知道现在的小姑娘是梦回一九八八还是怎么的，这种走沙雕路线穿品如衣服的人设，竟然从一群小奶狗小狼狗老干部中脱颖而出，意外的吃香。        柚子不太爱在社交软件上说话，所以他的微博大部分时间都不是自己打理。如果他的原创微博出现了“爱你们~”一类的字样，还配上了自拍，那多半是经纪人姐姐又上线了。评论区里都是一水的：小戴姐姐辛苦了！经纪人姐姐又帮忙来发微博了！小戴姐姐以后能悄悄拍一下狗柚子的胖脸凑个九宫格吗？好久不见了，甚是想念。        但是如果只有一句“钵钵鸡们，我来了”这几个字，粉丝们就知道是柚子上线了。        柚子自己也不知道为什么他比那些Alpha主播更圈粉，自己在老爹老娘面前就是三棍子，不五棍子打不出来一个闷屁的性格。         每次参加斗鱼举办的活动的时候都是假笑的站在那里神游，被其他人提醒后才反应过来应两句：嗯嗯嗯，对对对，就是这样，你说的太棒了！后来一度被钵钵鸡们嘲笑是在幻想自己是阿珂疯狂想戳主持人嗯嗯。         其实他内心没有这么污的，他只是不知道在台上干什么，放不开。然后得了一个活动黑人的标签。归根结底，大概是他这个大脸盘子甚是让小姐姐们喜爱的缘故吧。

We have an unspoken agreement not to get involved, not to overthink, and not to judge. I remember when we were kids, we'd hide under the covers together, bitterly complaining about the few beatings Dad gave us, then hold each other and cry loudly. We used to cry because we felt everything would get better eventually. Now we dare not cry because we don't know when things will get better.

results.translation: #What I hope to have# #is someone who encourages and supports me# I am strong, to avoid making those who love me sad, but in reality I am fragile; I love to laugh, because it's a good method, yet I keep all the pain and hurt deep inside; I trust friends deeply, because I treat everyone sincerely, but often end up getting hurt; I am devoted, in a relationship I take it seriously, I mean every word and action, but it seems like none lead to results; I am foolish, afraid of making decisions, afraid of choices because I hesitate, what I need by my side is someone who encourages and supports me: I don't hate anyone who has left, because there are reasons for each departure, every relationship, every friend, distance, time, trust, personality, compatibility—these are all issues that need attention, if even one can't be reconciled, then it may not last until the end... Meeting is fate, leaving is also fate! I also look forward to the next relationship, friendship, but I am just afraid of the unpredictability of people's hearts, just don't know what mindset to face and maintain it with, isn't it true that sincerity and devotion can last? I don't know either, everyone looks forward to something better, but what is anticipated may not be good! To myself—2017/8/5 Lhasa · InterContinental Lhasa Paradise

results.translation: We only have one child at home, and we don't keep pets. He hugs his plush toy dog every day. He doesn't say "dog," he calls it "Woof Woof." He has to hold Woof Woof to sleep, and the first thing he does when he wakes up in the morning is look for Woof Woof. He even found a small bucket for Woof Woof to use as a toilet, saying Woof Woof needs to pee, and then he pretends to pour the pee into the toilet (of course, there's no pee, it's just pretend). When we go out and he sees a real dog that can run, he asks for Woof Woof. If we tell him Woof Woof is at home, he'll wait until we get back to ask for Woof Woof. So adorable. Right now, the child is asleep. I was lying on the pillow looking at my phone and thought I smelled a dog-like odor. Could it be from Woof Woof? I looked up, and Woof Woof was right there by the bed.

results.translation: #ChangshaLife##GreenLeafFruitStore# Last Sunday around 9 PM, I bought some fruit at the Green Leaf Fruit store. Unexpectedly, when I went to buy fruit again today, the store manager checked the video and clearly saw that after scanning, the cashier inexplicably didn't put that bag of yellow peaches into the plastic bag but placed it on the left side of the checkout counter. The facts are very clear, but the store manager deliberately played dumb, delayed, and didn't answer how to resolve this issue. Although these yellow peaches are only about 10 yuan, the attitude of "Green Leaf Fruit" is ridiculous!!! "Green Leaf Fruit" has dozens of branches in Changsha. If every store is like this, liking to take petty advantages, I believe it won't be long before "Green Leaf Fruit" disappears from Changsha. Changsha

results.translation: I once asked a friend studying physics if life has reincarnation. He said no, but humans are made of particles, and so is everything in the universe. After a person's body perishes, the particles disperse and recombine throughout the cosmos—they simply exist in another form. As long as we remember them, they never truly vanish. This romantic notion comforts me; the departed are gone, and the living must carry on with courage.

What partings and reunions, how much joy and sorrow—they are merely the pastimes of people's lives. I am stranded, missing you like an illness, enduring. You walk in the rain, holding an umbrella alone, seeking your own happiness. How many memories drift, how many expectations linger? results.post_full: 我可以疯狂大笑，可以接住你们的乱梗，可以撒娇卖萌，甚至可以不顾形象配合你们高歌欢唱。在我们有接触的这段时间里我可以保持眼带笑意，但大多数时候我是寂寞的，我的心脏并不会因为我的活蹦乱跳而加速，相反的，我几乎感觉不到它的跳动。很多时候，我都在怀疑自己是不是其实已经不在人世，所有的一切不快乐，也都只是我的错觉。可能我这整个人都是不存在的，所有的思考都是无意义的，这样的话，自己这么排斥未来，包括莫名出现的绝望心灰和毫不期待的情绪也终于说得通了。我的周边没有坏人，我却依旧憎恨世界。不是他们的问题，是我有病，我不配这个世界。对不起，抱歉。
results.translation: I can laugh hysterically, catch your random jokes, act cute and coquettish, and even sing joyfully with you without caring about my image. During the time we interact, I can keep a smile in my eyes, but most of the time I am lonely. My heart does not beat faster because of my liveliness; on the contrary, I can hardly feel it beating. Often, I wonder if I am actually no longer alive, and all the unhappiness is just my illusion. Perhaps my entire existence is not real, and all my thoughts are meaningless. If so, my rejection of the future, including the inexplicable despair, despondency, and lack of anticipation, finally makes sense. There are no bad people around me, yet I still hate the world. It's not their problem; I am sick, I don't deserve this world. Sorry, I apologize.

results.translation: In my era, video games were still referred to as "electronic heroin" by people. When you showed a passion for video games, everyone around you would invariably tell you things like "indulging in play saps the will" or "playing games leads to no future." Today, however, video games have evolved into esports and are gradually gaining acceptance among the mainstream. Esports is also becoming more standardized, professionalized, and internationalized step by step. In the future, I hope there will be a game that can simulate the most realistic battlefield, providing a safe, efficient, and low-cost solution for international disputes, so that war never recurs and peace endures forever.

results.translation: One month anniversary of the breakup. Perhaps fate is just like this, what isn't meant to be mine will never be mine, what he likes he still likes. After the sadness, growth is inevitable; continuing to wallow will only harm myself. Last night, I had a dream in the middle of the night and was so upset I couldn't sleep, maybe I was just too angry. I think I might be too weak; it's time to face things as they are and be brave. Fear solves nothing. Let it go. I took off the keychain, I put the watch at the bottom of the box, maybe that will reduce the chances of seeing things and thinking of the person. Sometimes I really hate my good memory.

results.post_full: 这6年来，经常梦见我一故人，但是我们已经十多年没有见过了这6年来，都会过一段时间梦见他，梦是不一样，就是经常会梦见他几乎总是同样的感觉，朦胧，纠结，想念，憧憬梦见我很想告诉他什么，但是总是他不认识我，或者和我错过，总是让我很伤心。他是我小学的一个老师，我小学五，六年纪的时候不知道什么时候开始做梦梦见他，但现实中我是一点也不会想他，也没有交集的那种，真的像陌生人一样，十多年没见了。但是现在梦见好多年了，我现在都不清楚我为什么老梦见他。每次做完梦，我都要想一想，这是现实还是梦但是过几天，我都会忘记，忘记他，忘记这个梦，但是等我下次做梦，我梦见他的时候，我心里感觉好像又有他，我不知道为什么会这样，而且我也不想再梦见他！不是我刻意去寻找答案是梦见他快6年了 西安·高陵县
results.translation: For the past six years, I often dream of a deceased person, though we haven't seen each other for over a decade. Every so often during these six years, I dream of him. The dreams vary, but I frequently dream of him, almost always with the same feelings: hazy, entangled, longing, yearning. In the dreams, I really want to tell him something, but he always doesn't recognize me, or we miss each other, which always makes me very sad. He was a teacher from my elementary school. I started dreaming of him at some point during fifth or sixth grade, but in reality, I don't think of him at all, and we have no connection—truly like strangers, as we haven't met for over ten years. But now I've been dreaming of him for many years, and I still don't understand why I keep dreaming of him. After each dream, I have to think about whether it was real or a dream, but after a few days, I forget—forget him, forget the dream. Yet, the next time I dream of him, it feels like he's back in my heart. I don't know why this happens, and I don't want to dream of him anymore! It's not that I deliberately seek answers; it's been almost six years of dreaming of him. Xi'an, Gaoling County.

results.translation: I think the coolest thing I've done recently was my solo trip to Chengdu over a week ago. Stepping onto Chengdu's soil after getting off the plane, I felt a lightness from inside out. I love the simple and warm-hearted Sichuan people who call you "little sister, come eat!" and tease you in Sichuan-accented Mandarin with phrases like "what the heck are you laughing at." I love the spicy, fragrant kick of Sichuan hotpot and have come to accept the oil dipping sauce. I love Chengdu's bustling street life. I love the streets lined with ginkgo trees. Only after experiencing it did I truly understand the joy of solo travel—freedom, ease, real stress relief. I finally grasped the meaning of the saying "the young shouldn't enter Sichuan, the old shouldn't leave it." Chengdu's comfort is truly perfect for living, with endlessly delightful food and stunningly good-looking locals. It's just so damn comfortable.

results.translation: The leader had a talk with me. He is conflicted, on one hand wanting to win me over, on the other hand repeatedly saying we are not the same kind of person. But today I didn't handle it well. Knowing full well what he wanted to hear, yet constrained by worldly conscience and so-called frankness, I foolishly drew a clear line with the leader. I even said his planning advantages are obvious, but he lacks management ability. It felt really satisfying at the time. I've always been stung by him, now let him also experience the taste of being belittled, of having someone express disapproval to his face without mercy. Looking back now, I still think I was childish. What's wrong with saying what others love to hear, want to hear? Next time remember to say what everyone chooses to hear. It's not like you don't understand his character.

results.post_full: 四肢上长了白癜风怎么治疗恢复得快?　　想要疾病好得快，那么首先患者对于疾病就需要有更多的认识。白癜风治疗难度很大，长在四肢处白斑更加不好治。肢端型白癜风是白癜风类型中患病率较高，且治疗难度比较复杂的一种。那么，四肢上长了白癜风怎么治疗恢复得快?　　肢端型白癜风治疗不可盲目　　很多患者由于心系病情，很容易被别人钻空子，盲目听信所谓的偏方、特效药。可能在刚开始时，患者可以看到一些效果，但是时间久了，患者就会看到白斑扩散越加严重。因此，建议患者不要盲目使用偏方、药物进行治疗。肢端型白癜风本身治疗难度就比较大，想要治好它，只有靠科学医治才能够解决这一困扰。而不是盲目治疗、胡乱用药，那样只会适得其反。　　面对疾病及时调整好心态康复得更快　　被疾病缠上，相信大家都不会有好心情，但是如果患者们不能及时调整好自己心态的话，那么也会直接影响到病情。据临床表明，因为肢端型白癜风严重影响个人形象，很多病人在治疗时都会十分担忧自身疾病能否得到比较好的治疗，是否可以快速的治好。所以，很多患者也会产生不同程度心理问题。精神状况对于白癜风治疗影响非常大。思想压力大了，对自己身体造成了影响不说，患者还会出现情绪低落到不愿意配合治疗的情况，白癜风的治疗效果会大大降低。　　温馨提示：面对顽疾，靠患者自己或者光靠医生都不能完美地解决这一困扰，想要疾病好得快，除了要有个好医院、好技术以外，患者自身配合度也十分重要。因此，患者一定要积极配合医生治疗，坚持白癜风护理，争取早日恢复健康。
results.translation: How to treat and recover quickly from vitiligo on the limbs? To recover quickly from the disease, patients first need to have a better understanding of it. Vitiligo is difficult to treat, and white patches on the limbs are even harder to cure. Acral vitiligo is a type with a high prevalence and complex treatment difficulty. So, how can vitiligo on the limbs be treated for a fast recovery? Do not treat acral vitiligo blindly. Many patients, due to their concern about the condition, are easily taken advantage of and blindly believe in so-called folk remedies or miracle drugs. Initially, patients may see some effects, but over time, they will notice the white patches spreading more severely. Therefore, it is recommended that patients avoid blindly using folk remedies or medications for treatment. Acral vitiligo itself is challenging to treat; to cure it, only scientific medical treatment can resolve this issue. Blind treatment or胡乱用药 (haphazard medication) will only backfire. Adjusting mindset promptly leads to faster recovery. Being afflicted by a disease, it's understandable that no one feels good, but if patients cannot adjust their mindset in time, it will directly affect the condition. Clinical observations show that because acral vitiligo severely impacts personal appearance, many patients worry greatly during treatment about whether their disease can be effectively treated and cured quickly. Consequently, many patients also develop varying degrees of psychological issues. Mental state significantly influences vitiligo treatment. Excessive psychological pressure not only affects one's body but can also lead to low mood and unwillingness to cooperate with treatment, greatly reducing the effectiveness of vitiligo treatment. Reminder: Facing a stubborn disease, relying solely on the patient or the doctor cannot perfectly resolve this issue. To recover quickly, besides having a good hospital and technology, the patient's own cooperation is also crucial. Therefore, patients must actively cooperate with doctors, persist in vitiligo care, and strive for an early recovery to health.

results.translation: That was a girl I encountered from the starting station, alone pushing her suitcase. The only conversation we had was when she kept looking for her seat, I happened to hear it and pointed it out to her, she said thank you, and she was a few rows behind me. Later, because there were fewer people in the back carriages and it was hot and crowded in the front, I went to the back carriages a few times. When I came back, I didn’t see her a few times and thought she had gotten off early, but then I saw her a few times standing alone or staying in a corner. I felt we had quite a bit in common, so I really wanted to get to know her. On the way to downtown, a few people talked to her, and I listened from a few meters away. The reason I stayed so far was because I studied accounting, and at home the required score was too high, 580. That strong inner thought, "Hello, I’d like to get to know you," was vetoed by a sense of inferiority, as if I had been defeated again.

This past month, I've seen too much that makes the world seem not worth it, encountered a suffocating, surreal world, making ordinary, peaceful life feel incredibly precious. I remember when I first liked him, just saying a word or making a joke would make my heart race. At night back at the hotel, recalling moments from the day, feeling sweet and unable to sleep, thinking how well-matched our likes and interests are, we're so in sync. After being together, I found that in all those similarities, he's much better than me—good at everything, knows everything. He's actually the type to keep many thoughts quietly to himself. Sometimes I'm not sure how much he likes me. But I feel like I've met my own little sun, a light I can always chase, illuminating me. Happy Valentine's Day, my little sun.

results.translation: Recently I dug out the letter my mom wrote to me on my 18th birthday in 2018. I had gone out drinking that day and came back drunk, so I didn’t read it until the next day. Then, when a variety show mentioned the meaning of letters, I remembered it and took it out to read again. I feel my mindset has changed a lot. Two years have passed in a blink, and I’ve grown up a bit more. I feel my mom has become more tolerant toward me, maybe because she thinks I won’t be by her side much longer. results.translation: #Choi Seung-ri Suffers from Severe Depression# Every time I see or hear news about depression, I truly feel sad and scared. A young girl in the prime of her life was killed bit by bit. Yes, perhaps for her it was a happy thing, but for those who liked and loved her, it is another kind of pain. I can truly understand the despair she once experienced—completely misunderstood and misinterpreted by those who didn’t understand. She hoped to be understood, but the world only seeks momentary gratification. Everyone thinks depression is scary, but I believe what’s truly terrifying are those words that push depression patients step by step toward death—irresponsible, offhand remarks that may not be outright malicious. When you cannot control the other self within your body driving you toward death, the pain is unbearable. When you can only bring sadness to those around you, you feel so guilty, thinking you should die, that you shouldn’t exist in this world. Your disappearance might be a case of “short pain rather than long pain” for everyone. Everyone panics because of depression, but no one ever considers that the disease itself isn’t scary—what’s scary is the uncontrollable human heart. Ma’anshan · Anhui University of Technology East Campus

results.post_full: 就很害怕，刺探军情让留电话号码，我想了想没有留我自己的，或许是脑子抽抽了，留得之前我爸的号，就算我已经再也不会给这个号码打电话，但是因为qq登录密码一直是他手机号，所以从来也没忘记。但是我大意了，人死之后，手机号一直交着费用也是可以用的吧，毕竟营业厅只看余额。或许号码在哪个亲戚手里吧，我前脚留电话，后脚看见我留的电话给我打电话，惊悚程度可见一斑，电话恐惧症当场发作我必须得承认我的自私和薄情，无论那些和我还有着些微血缘关系的人是要关心还是要询问什么，我始终认可的血亲就是只此一个且已不在人世。而剩下的人留给我的只有梦魇，我也不明白一件屁大点事怎么会成为我的梦魇，但是就是这样。我做重复的梦，很多次，我不想回去，开始挣扎，之后一味得逃，后来就在梦里自我毁灭。这种百分百不问缘由的逃离，或许在我真的决定去死的那一刻也不会变。
results.translation: I'm just really scared. They were probing for military information and asked for a phone number. I thought about it and didn't give my own. Maybe my brain short-circuited, but I gave my dad's old number instead. Even though I'll never call that number again, I've never forgotten it because it was always his number for QQ login passwords. But I was careless. After someone dies, if you keep paying the fees, the phone number can still be used, right? After all, the service provider only checks the balance. Maybe the number is in some relative's hands. Right after I left the number, I saw a call coming in from that very number. The horror of that moment is hard to describe—my phone phobia instantly flared up. I have to admit my selfishness and coldness. No matter if those people who still share a faint blood tie with me want to show concern or ask something, the only blood relative I truly acknowledge is that one person, and they're no longer in this world. The others have left me with nothing but nightmares. I don't understand how such a trivial matter could become my nightmare, but it just did. I have the same dream repeatedly, many times. I don't want to go back, I start struggling, then I just run away, and later in the dream, I self-destruct. This instinct to flee without asking any questions probably won't change even at the moment I truly decide to die.

results.post_full: 白斑病是一种病因复杂的皮肤病，很多原因都会导致白癜风疾病，这种疾病一旦患上会给人们的身心造成很大的困扰，那么秋季白癜风患者患病的原因是什么?　　外伤：外伤是白斑病的常见病因，外伤的出现会导致身体局部免疫异常、气血不和，免疫异常会对黑色素细胞造成损害，影响黑色素合成，从而诱发白斑病，白斑病是在气血失和的基础上引起的。除了外伤外，还会对皮肤造成其他刺激如抓挠、摩擦、接触有害化学物质等。　　阳光暴晒：阳光照晒可以促进黑色素合成，使人的皮肤变黑，但在阳光下长期暴晒会使皮肤上出现白斑，诱发白斑病。阳光暴晒会使黑色素细胞功能亢奋，过多的消耗黑色素细胞，使黑色素细胞过早衰亡，使黑色素无法正常合成，从而使人的皮肤上出现白斑。　　精神因素：精神因素也是白斑病的常见病因之一，很多人得白斑病的原因就是因为长期心理压力过大、精神压抑或受到严重刺激所致，各种不良情绪、心理起伏较大都会造成精神内分泌失调，影响免疫功能，从而对黑色素细胞造成损害，诱发白斑病出现。
results.translation: Vitiligo is a skin disease with complex causes, and many factors can lead to the condition. Once contracted, it can cause significant physical and psychological distress. So, what are the causes of vitiligo in autumn? Trauma: Trauma is a common cause of vitiligo. The occurrence of trauma can lead to local immune abnormalities and imbalance of qi and blood in the body. Immune abnormalities can damage melanocytes, affecting melanin synthesis and thus triggering vitiligo, which is based on an imbalance of qi and blood. In addition to trauma, other skin irritations such as scratching, friction, and exposure to harmful chemicals can also contribute. Sun exposure: Sunlight can promote melanin synthesis, darkening the skin, but prolonged exposure to the sun can cause white patches on the skin and induce vitiligo. Sun exposure can overstimulate melanocytes, excessively depleting them and causing premature aging, which prevents normal melanin synthesis and leads to white patches on the skin. Psychological factors: Psychological factors are also a common cause of vitiligo. Many people develop vitiligo due to long-term excessive psychological stress, depression, or severe emotional shocks. Various negative emotions and significant psychological fluctuations can lead to endocrine imbalances, affect immune function, damage melanocytes, and trigger vitiligo.

results.post_full: 2006年斩获第一个慢性病——近视2010年斩获第二个慢性病——咽炎2011年斩获第三个慢性病——鼻炎2016年斩获第四个慢性病——抑郁症2019年斩获第五个慢性病——前列腺炎同年斩获第六个慢性病——浅表性胃炎同年斩获第七个慢性病——牙周炎2020年9月14日收割第八个慢性病——脊柱侧弯下周做心脏彩超。期待第九个慢性病的到来。我真的认真想过，把过去的四年彻底推倒重建后，那个焕然一新的阿雪诞生的一天。为了那个他，这一个多月来哪怕我累到多疯想要放弃，只要有一个人温柔地跟我说“坚持一下”，我就会爬起来。但是今天我真的累了。我拼不动了。我不知道怎么跟三天后那个23岁的自己交代。摆在我心里的跨栏太多了。我跨过一个，腿还疼着，你们就告诉我快跨下一个；现在我想破罐子破摔了，真的。我早不就输了吗。
results.translation: 2006 acquired the first chronic illness - myopia 2010 acquired the second chronic illness - pharyngitis 2011 acquired the third chronic illness - rhinitis 2016 acquired the fourth chronic illness - depression 2019 acquired the fifth chronic illness - prostatitis same year acquired the sixth chronic illness - superficial gastritis same year acquired the seventh chronic illness - periodontitis September 14, 2020 harvested the eighth chronic illness - scoliosis next week getting a cardiac ultrasound. Looking forward to the arrival of the ninth chronic illness. I've really seriously thought about it, the day when, after completely demolishing and rebuilding the past four years, a brand-new Axue is born. For that him, over this past month, no matter how exhausted and crazy I felt wanting to give up, as long as one person gently told me "hang in there a bit," I would get back up. But today I'm really tired. I can't fight anymore. I don't know how to account for myself to the 23-year-old me three days from now. There are too many hurdles placed in my heart. I clear one, my leg still hurts, and you all tell me to hurry and clear the next one; now I feel like giving up completely and letting things go to hell, really. Haven't I already lost long ago?

results.post_full: #大学快要毕业时是什么感觉# 今天想来聊一聊kavien哥，一个从新浪做技术转型到创业公司做猎头的传奇人物，有过十几年的摇滚经历，非常年轻的容貌配上沉稳的内心，在下很佩服！今天临近下班时候，碰巧有机会再多聊几句，其实还蛮深刻，转型时自己是空杯心态，认识了很多人，多数都是行业tp，敲代码时已经到去药店不知道怎么买药，每天吃喝都在工位，沟通只求简洁高效，所以现在不惧怕回炉重造，其实很多人缺的不是能力，而是这股认定做到底的勇气，所有人包括父母都不支持，但是我觉得我可以试一把！Just to do it！所以 我现在觉得 我也可以再试一把！2020一起加油吧💪#2020 爱你爱你# 北京·西北旺
results.translation: #What does it feel like when you're about to graduate from college# Today I want to talk about Brother Kavien, a legendary figure who transitioned from technology at Sina to becoming a headhunter at a startup, with over a decade of rock music experience, a very youthful appearance paired with a steady heart—I truly admire him! Just before getting off work today, I happened to have the chance to chat a bit more, and it was quite profound. During his transition, he maintained an empty-cup mindset, met many people, most of whom were industry top performers. When coding, he reached a point where he didn’t even know how to buy medicine at a pharmacy, eating and drinking at his workstation every day, communicating only for brevity and efficiency, so now he isn’t afraid to start over. In fact, what many people lack isn’t ability, but the courage to commit fully. Everyone, including his parents, didn’t support him, but he thought he could give it a try! Just to do it! So now I feel like I can give it another try too! Let’s work hard together in 2020 💪 #2020 Love You Love You# Beijing · Northwest Wang

results.post_full: 我见过在深夜黑暗中哽咽的人，我见过宿舍人都睡了之后偷偷在被子里抽泣的人，我见过偷偷跑到楼道里痛哭的人，我见的这些都是女生，是在感情中受伤的女生，不可否认我也曾是其中之一。不明白男生为何钟情于冷暴力的方法处理感情问题，若有问题好好沟通，沟通解决得了那就继续，若无果就光明磊落结束。我始终认为每一份感情都值得认真对待。冷暴力实在是让人受尽折磨，是那句话:对你仍有爱意，对你我都无能为力。愿大家好梦✨
results.translation: I have seen people sobbing in the darkness of late night, I have seen people secretly weeping under their blankets after everyone in the dorm has fallen asleep, I have seen people sneaking into the hallway to cry bitterly. All those I have seen are girls, girls wounded in relationships. Undeniably, I was once one of them. I don't understand why boys are so fond of using the silent treatment to handle relationship issues. If there's a problem, communicate properly. If communication can resolve it, then continue; if not, end it openly and honestly. I have always believed that every relationship deserves to be taken seriously. The silent treatment is truly torturous. It's like that saying: I still have feelings for you, but I am powerless for both of us. Wishing everyone sweet dreams ✨
